programme.title: Kaagaz 2
programme.desc: The Struggles of a common man whose right to life is infringed upon by protests and rallies. Release Year: 2024 Director: V.K. Prakash.

programme.title: Fan
programme.desc: Gaurav's world revolves around the superstar Aryan Khanna. What happens when his passion turns into a dangerous obsession that crosses the fine line? Release Year: 2016 Director: Maneesh Sharma Awards: 2017 Winner Technical Award- Best Special Effects, 2017 Winner Technical Award- Best Makeup- Greg Cannom.

programme.title: Yamla Pagla Deewana Phir Se
programme.desc: An army officer squares off against drug lords and Russian henchmen to save his ex-lover's kidnapped daughter in the underbelly of Goa, India. Release Year: 2018 Director: Navaniat Singh.

programme.title: Ek Tha Tiger
programme.desc: Agent Tiger is sent to Dublin to observe a scientist. There he falls in love with the latter's caretaker, who is an ISI agent. Release Year: 2012 Director: Kabir Khan Awards: People's Choice Awards- Favorite Movie, Favourite Movie Actor- Salman Khan, Favourite Action Movie Star- Salman.

programme.title: Aankhen
programme.desc: When Vijay Singh Rajput is unceremoniously stripped of his duties as a bank manager, he decides to seek revenge by robbing the bank. He trains three blind men to do the job for him. Release Year: 2002 Director: Vipul Amrutlal Shah.

programme.title: Jolly Llb 3
programme.desc: Two lawyers sharing the name Jolly-Mishra and Tyagi-lock horns in a clever courtroom showdown, using sharp wit and outrageous antics that turn legal battles into comic chaos. Release Year: 2025 Director: Subhash Kapoor Awards: 2025 Winner Surfers' Choice Award- Best Actor in a Comic Role- Arshad Warsi.

programme.title: Sanjeevani
programme.desc: Many people go in search of a mysterious plant that can bring people back to life. But, upon reaching there, they encounter strange creatures, from whom they have to run away.

programme.title: Jayeshbhai Jordaar
programme.desc: A timid Jayesh must defy his patriarchal family as he flees with his wife to save their unborn daughter from foeticide. Release Year: 2022 Director: Divyang Thakkar.

programme.title: The President Is Coming
programme.desc: Six young contestants undergo bizarre tests and stop at nothing to top the list of the young faces responsible for shaping 'The New India' and eventually meet George Bush.

programme.title: Monsoon Shootout
programme.desc: Adi, a policeman, joins an anti-extortion unit of the Mumbai Police led by Khan. When an ambush goes wrong, Adi chases a wanted gangster, Shiva. Release Year: 2013 Director: Amit Kumar.

programme.title: Jamai Raja
programme.desc: When the wealthy Durgeshwari's daughter falls in love with Raja, a poor boy, she reluctantly agrees to their union. However, she constantly tries to sabotage their relationship, but Raja outwits her. Release Year: 1990 Director: A. Kodandarami Reddy.

programme.title: Aisha
programme.desc: Aisha, who loves playing matchmaker much to her friend Arjun's disapproval, finds a new target in the simple Shefali. But in the process, she ends up ruining her own relationship with close friends. Release Year: 2010 Director: Rajshree Ojha Awards: Stardust Award for Breakthrough Performance - Female Amrita Puri.

programme.title: Mere Brother Ki Dulhan
programme.desc: A quirky Northern Indian rom-com about Kush seeking a bride for his brother, only to fall for her himself, triggering chaotic, comedic, heartwarming consequences. Release Year: 2011 Director: Ali Abbas Zafar Awards: Stardust Awards- Superstar of Tomorrow Male- Imran Khan.

programme.title: Bhoothnath Returns
programme.desc: A ghost returns from his 'Bhoothworld' where he is mocked for his inability to scare children. On Earth, he has something more to do for his country. Release Year: 2014 Director: Nitesh Tiwari Awards: National Film Awards- Special Mention- Parth Bhalerao For Killa.

programme.title: Ready
programme.desc: Prem in love with Sanjana whose uncles are behind her massive bank account. The story is about how they teach a lesson to her uncles. Release Year: 2011 Director: Anees Bazmee Awards: BIG Star Entertainment Awards 2011: Most Entertaining Film, Stardust Awards 2012: Star of the Year - Male Salman Khan, Stardust Awards 2012: Standout Performance by a Lyricist Ashish Pandit for 'Dhinka Chika'.

programme.title: Lafangey Parindey
programme.desc: After an accident leaves aspiring dancer Pinky blind, Nandan helps her rebuild her confidence. Together, they overcome challenges as she prepares to pursue her dream on a reality show. Release Year: 2010 Director: Pradeep Sarkar.

programme.title: Mujhse Dosti Karoge
programme.desc: Raj loves Tina and Pooja loves Raj. When they meet years later, he and Pooja fall in love but she rejects his marriage proposal.

programme.title: Parole
programme.desc: Two brothers, one a criminal, grow closer after their mother dies. The younger brother tries to get the older one paroled so he can perform her last rites.

programme.title: The Legend Of Michael Mishra
programme.desc: Michael Mishra, a kidnapper from Patna, falls for a girl, Varsha Shukla, at a very young age. He got arrested and sent to jail. Release Year: 2016 Director: Manish Jha.

programme.title: Titli
programme.desc: When a young man attempts to escape the life of carjacking that his brothers have planned for him, he finds an unlikely ally in Neelu, the woman they've arranged for him to marry. Release Year: 2014 Director: Kanu Behl, Kanu Bhel Awards: Ranvir Shorey, Amit Sial, Amit Sial.

programme.title: Rowdy Sarkar
programme.desc: Dreams of an aspiring cricketer comes crashing down when he is engulfed in a false naxal case and turns to a life of crime, gaining the name of Railway Raju.

programme.title: Shor Se Shuruaat
programme.desc: An anthology of seven short films that revolve around the theme of noise and depict real-life issues. Release Year: 2016 Director: Amira Bhargava, Rahul V. Chittella, Satish Raj Kasireddi.

programme.title: Gharwali Baharwali
programme.desc: Arun marries Kaajal because his dad wants grandchildren. She fails to conceive. Chaos descends as she finds that Arun is having an affair. Release Year: 1998 Director: David Dhawan.

programme.title: No Problem
programme.desc: After bank owner, Zandulal's money is stolen by Yash and Raj Ambani, he faces financial ruin and sets out to apprehend the duo. Release Year: 2010 Director: Anees Bazmee Awards: 2011 Nominee Popular Award- Best Comic Actor- Anil Kapoor.

programme.title: Bol Bachchan
programme.desc: Bol Bachchan.

programme.title: Sarfira
programme.desc: A common man dreams of starting his own airline amidst the competitive world of startups and aviation. His journey is filled with challenges, risks, and aspirations to turn his dream into reality. Release Year: 2024 Director: Sudha Kongara Awards: 2024 Winner Popular Award- Mould Breaker of the Year- Radhika Madan.

programme.title: Blind
programme.desc: Ex-cop Gia Singh grows suspicious of a stranger and alerts the police. When they ignore her gut feeling, she takes matters into her own hands to find the truth. Release Year: 2023 Director: Shome Makhija Awards: Filmfare OTT Awards Nomination for Best Production Design: Paul Rowan 2023.

programme.title: Golmaal-Returns
programme.desc: Ekta Santoshi, obsessed with daytime soaps, suspects her husband Gopal of cheating. Her investigation spirals into hilarious chaos, leading to Gopal's wrongful arrest for a murder he didn't commit! Release Year: 2008 Director: Rohit Shetty Awards: 2009 Winner Reader's Choice- Best Supporting Actor- TuSShar Kapoor.

programme.title: Sadak Chaap
programme.desc: Shankar is a petty thief who lives on the streets and knows nothing about his parents. He somehow learns that his father is alive and meets him and unfolds a well-guarded conspiracy. Release Year: 1987 Director: Anil Ganguly.

programme.title: Lamhe
programme.desc: Viren falls for Pallavi, but she marries Siddharth. The couple dies, leaving behind their daughter, who grows up to look just like her mother and falls in love with Viren. Release Year: 1991 Director: Yash Chopra Awards: Filmfare Awards- Best Film - Yash Chopra, Best Story - Honey Irani, Best Dialogue - Rahi Masoom Raza, Best Costume Design - Neeta Lulla.

programme.title: Hulla
programme.desc: Raj and his wife expect peace in the their new flat. But thanks to the watchman's whistle Raj becomes sleep-deprived. Release Year: 2008 Director: Jaideep Varma.

programme.title: Raghuveer
programme.desc: Raghuveer is arrested and imprisoned on false charges. His police officer brother, Ravi, is enraged and severs all ties with him. Release Year: 1995 Director: K. Pappu.

programme.title: Guru
programme.desc: Guru, a determined dreamer, leaves his small village with his wife to chase his goal of starting his own business, embracing new challenges and opportunities on the road to success.

programme.title: Jhoom Barabar Jhoom
programme.desc: A man and a woman, engaged to marry different people, spend a couple of hours chatting together at a train station only to fall for each other. Release Year: 2007 Director: Shaad Ali.

programme.title: Badmaash Company
programme.desc: Karan, a middle-class graduate, is heartbroken when his mother sells her jewelry for his father's treatment. Determined to fix it, he hatches a plan to get rich fast, risking everything. Release Year: 2010 Director: Parmeet Sethi.

programme.title: Mujhse Shaadi Karogi
programme.desc: In Goa, Sameer falls for Rani, but his roommate Sunny, also smitten, sabotages Sameer's chances, sparking a heated rivalry for Rani's heart, testing friendship and love. Release Year: 2004 Director: David Dhawan Awards: Best Art Direction: Sharmishta Roy Screen Weekly Awards; Best Performance in a Comic Role: Akshay Kumar, Best Background Score, Best Costume Design Awards of the International Indian Film Academy.

programme.title: Angrezi Medium
programme.desc: Though Champak initially disapproves, he eventually does everything in his power while going through a series of hilarious mishaps to fulfil his daughter's dream of going to London to study further. Release Year: 2020 Director: Homi Adajania Awards: 2021 Winner Filmfare Award- Best Actor- Irrfan Khan.

programme.title: Travel Diaries Of Healer And Rohan

programme.desc: పరిశోధనా కేంద్రం నుండి తప్పించుకుని బయటి ప్రపంచంలో అడుగుపెట్టిన మాక్స్, గోల్డ్ ఫిష్ లు అనేక సాహసాలు చేస్తారు.

programme.title: హంటర్ X హంటర్
programme.sub-title: Gon Freecss sets out to become a Hunter, an elite professional known for hunting rare monsters and treasures, in the hopes of finding his absent father
programme.desc: గాన్ ఫ్రీక్స్, అదృశ్యమైన తన తండ్రిని వెతకాలనే ఆశతో, అరుదైన రాక్షసులు, నిధిని వేటాడే హంటర్‌గా మారడానికి సిద్దమవుతాడు.

programme.title: వన్ పీస్

programme.desc: యువకుడు మంకీ డి లఫ్ఫీ, అతని సముద్రపు దొంగల బృందం ఒక కల్పిత నిధిని కనుగొనడానికి ఉత్తేజకరమైన సాహసయాత్రను ప్రారంభిస్తారు.

programme.desc: పరిశోధనా కేంద్రం నుండి తప్పించుకుని బయటి ప్రపంచంలో అడుగుపెట్టిన మాక్స్, గోల్డ్ ఫిష్ లు అనేక సాహసాలు చేస్తారు.

programme.title: హంటర్ X హంటర్
programme.sub-title: Gon Freecss sets out to become a Hunter, an elite professional known for hunting rare monsters and treasures, in the hopes of finding his absent father
programme.desc: గాన్ ఫ్రీక్స్, అదృశ్యమైన తన తండ్రిని వెతకాలనే ఆశతో, అరుదైన రాక్షసులు, నిధిని వేటాడే హంటర్‌గా మారడానికి సిద్దమవుతాడు.

programme.title: వన్ పీస్
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: యువకుడు మంకీ డి లఫ్ఫీ, అతని సముద్రపు దొంగల బృందం ఒక కల్పిత నిధిని కనుగొనడానికి ఉత్తేజకరమైన సాహసయాత్రను ప్రారంభిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Mayumi Tanaka (Monkey D Luffy),Kazuya Nakai (Roronoa Zoro),Akemi Okamura (Nami),Kappei Yamaguchi (Usopp),Hiroaki Hirata (Sanji),Mahito Ôba

programme.title: కిటెరెట్సు
programme.sub-title: Kiteretsu, an elementary school student who uses his inventions to help people, and Korosuke, his robot, partake in various adventures along with his friends
programme.desc: ప్రాథమిక పాఠశాల విద్యార్థి కిటెరెట్సు, అతని రోబోట్ కొరోసుకే తన స్నేహితులతో కలిసి వివిధ సాహసాలలో పాల్గొంటారు.

credits.actor: Toshiko Fujita (Kiteretsu),Kazuko Sugiyama (Korosuke),Chieko Honda (Miyo),Yuji Mitsuya (Tongari),Mami Koyama (Korosuke),Mayumi Sho (Miyo)

programme.title: వీ బేర్ బేర్స్
programme.sub-title: Three brother bears, Grizzly, Panda, and Ice, awkwardly navigate life in the San Francisco Bay Area as they try to fit into modern human society
programme.desc: గ్రిజ్లీ, పాండా, ఐస్ లు ఆధునిక మానవ జీవితాన్ని గడిపే క్రమంలో శాన్ ఫ్రాన్సిస్కో బే ఏరియాలో ఇబ్బందులు ఎదుర్కొంటారు.

credits.actor: Bobby Moynihan (Panda),Eric Edelstein (Grizzly),Demetri Martin (Ice Bear),Charlyne Yi (Chloe),Patton Oswalt (Nom Nom),Jason Lee (Charlie)

programme.title: హ్యారీ అండ్ బన్నీ
programme.sub-title: Harry is an aspiring magician who invents elaborate magic tricks to impress others. However, Bunnie, his mischievous stage rabbit, constantly outsmarts him and steals his spotlight
programme.desc: హ్యారీ మాయ‌జాలం చేయ‌డానికి ప్ర‌య‌త్నించిన‌ప్పుడ‌ల్లా, బ‌న్నీ అనే కుందేలు అత‌ని ప్ర‌య‌త్నాన్ని నాశ‌నం చేయాల‌ని చూస్తుంది.

programme.desc: బేబీ లెమ్మింగ్స్ తమ ఆటపట్టు మరియు కుతూహల స్వభావంతో ఈ ప్రపంచంలో పయనిస్తూ, అనేక సవాళ్లను అధిగమించడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తాయి.

programme.title: లూనీ ట్యూన్స్ కార్టూన్స్
programme.sub-title: Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, Porky Pig, Sylvester, Tweety, Road Runner and many others go through a series of funny misadventures
programme.desc: బగ్స్ బన్నీ, డాఫీ డక్, పోర్కీ పిగ్, ట్వీటీ, రోడ్ రన్నర్, ఇతర పాత్రలు వరుస హాస్యాస్పదమైన సాహసాలను ఎదుర్కొంటాయి.

credits.actor: Eric Bauza (Bugs Bunny/Daffy Duck/Marvin the Martian/Tweety),Jeff Bergman (Elmer Fudd/Sylvester/Ralph Wolf),Bob Bergen (Porky Pig),Fred Tatasciore (Yosemite Sam/Gossamer/Sam Sheepdog),Candi Milo (Granny),Michael Ruocco (Beaky Buzzard)

programme.title: ఓమి నెం.1
programme.sub-title: Omi, an ultra-rich nine-year-old heir, encounters hilarious and eye-opening situations that teach him about the realities of life
programme.desc: సంపన్న వారసుడైన తొమ్మిదేళ్ల ఓమి, జీవితంలో ఎదురయ్యే సరదా, ఆశ్చర్యకరమైన పరిస్థితుల ద్వారా జీవిత సత్యాలు తెలుసుకుంటాడు.

programme.sub-title: Max, a bionic guinea pig, and his goldfish best friend embark on fascinating adventures after they escape the laboratory and try to fit in the wildlife
programme.desc: పరిశోధనా కేంద్రం నుండి తప్పించుకుని బయటి ప్రపంచంలో అడుగుపెట్టిన మాక్స్, గోల్డ్ ఫిష్ లు అనేక సాహసాలు చేస్తారు.

programme.title: హంటర్ X హంటర్
programme.sub-title: Gon Freecss sets out to become a Hunter, an elite professional known for hunting rare monsters and treasures, in the hopes of finding his absent father
programme.desc: గాన్ ఫ్రీక్స్, అదృశ్యమైన తన తండ్రిని వెతకాలనే ఆశతో, అరుదైన రాక్షసులు, నిధిని వేటాడే హంటర్‌గా మారడానికి సిద్దమవుతాడు.

programme.title: వన్ పీస్
programme.sub-title: Monkey D Luffy, a young man made of rubber, and his team of pirates embark on an exciting adventure to find a fabled treasure
programme.desc: యువకుడు మంకీ డి లఫ్ఫీ, అతని సముద్రపు దొంగల బృందం ఒక కల్పిత నిధిని కనుగొనడానికి ఉత్తేజకరమైన సాహసయాత్రను ప్రారంభిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Mayumi Tanaka (Monkey D Luffy),Kazuya Nakai (Roronoa Zoro),Akemi Okamura (Nami),Kappei Yamaguchi (Usopp),Hiroaki Hirata (Sanji),Mahito Ôba

programme.title: కిటెరెట్సు
programme.sub-title: Kiteretsu, an elementary school student who uses his inventions to help people, and Korosuke, his robot, partake in various adventures along with his friends
programme.desc: ప్రాథమిక పాఠశాల విద్యార్థి కిటెరెట్సు, అతని రోబోట్ కొరోసుకే తన స్నేహితులతో కలిసి వివిధ సాహసాలలో పాల్గొంటారు.

credits.actor: Toshiko Fujita (Kiteretsu),Kazuko Sugiyama (Korosuke),Chieko Honda (Miyo),Yuji Mitsuya (Tongari),Mami Koyama (Korosuke),Mayumi Sho (Miyo)

programme.title: వీ బేర్ బేర్స్
programme.sub-title: Three brother bears, Grizzly, Panda, and Ice, awkwardly navigate life in the San Francisco Bay Area as they try to fit into modern human society
programme.desc: గ్రిజ్లీ, పాండా, ఐస్ లు ఆధునిక మానవ జీవితాన్ని గడిపే క్రమంలో శాన్ ఫ్రాన్సిస్కో బే ఏరియాలో ఇబ్బందులు ఎదుర్కొంటారు.

credits.actor: Bobby Moynihan (Panda),Eric Edelstein (Grizzly),Demetri Martin (Ice Bear),Charlyne Yi (Chloe),Patton Oswalt (Nom Nom),Jason Lee (Charlie)

programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक योग और स्वास्थ्य संबंधी सुझावों के माध्यम से आध्यात्मिक अंतर्दृष्टि प्रदान करते हैं, तथा प्राकृतिक उपचारों पर ध्यान केंद्रित करते हुए आंतरिक शांति को बढ़ावा देते हैं।.

programme.title: योग ऋषि स्वामी रामदेवजी
programme.sub-title: Ancient techniques of meditation and adoption of specific bodily postures widely practised for health and relaxation
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक योग और स्वास्थ्य संबंधी सुझावों के माध्यम से आध्यात्मिक अंतर्दृष्टि प्रदान करते हैं, तथा प्राकृतिक उपचारों पर ध्यान केंद्रित करते हुए आंतरिक शांति को बढ़ावा देते हैं।.

programme.title: रोगानुसार आयुर्वेद एवं जीवन दर्शन
programme.sub-title: Acharya Balkrishna Ji, a prominent yoga and Ayurveda scholar, talks about the importance of medicinal plants and their uses
programme.desc: प्रमुख योग और आयुर्वेद विद्वान आचार्य बालकृष्ण जी विभिन्न औषधीय पौधों के महत्व और उनके उपयोग के बारे में बात करते हैं।.

programme.title: पूज्या दीदी मां ऋतंभराजी
programme.sub-title: A religious leader delivers an enlightening discourse on the holy scriptures and encourages devotees to live a spiritual life
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथ-प्रदर्शक पवित्र शास्त्रों पर ज्ञानवर्धक प्रवचन देते हैं और भक्तों को आध्यात्मिक जीवन जीने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: संत राजिंदर सिंहजी
programme.sub-title: Sant Rajinder Singh Ji Maharaj, current head of Science of Spirituality or Sawan Kirpal Ruhani Mission, is internationally recognised for his work towards inner and outer peace through spirituality
programme.desc: एक आध्यात्मिक पथप्रदर्शक संत राजिंदर सिंहजी महाराज आध्यात्मिकता और रहस्यवाद के बारे में प्रवचन देते हैं जो अपने कार्यों के लिए अंतरराष्ट्रीय स्तर पर पहचाने जाते हैं।.

programme.title: पूज्य सतपालजी महाराज
programme.sub-title: Shri Satpal Ji Maharaj's mission is primarily to ignite the spiritual flame in man. The knowledge he teaches, frees one from all restrictions and liberates the mind from all layers of ignorance
programme.desc: एक आध्यात्मिक पथप्रदर्शक भक्ति और आत्म-साक्षात्कार से परिचय कराते हैं, तथा दर्शकों को आंतरिक शांति और जीवन के उद्देश्य की गहरी समझ की ओर मार्गदर्शन करते हैं।.

programme.title: साधु कैलाश मानव
programme.sub-title: Narayan Seva Sansthan is committed to providing free food and medical services to poor people
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक विद्वान हिंदू धर्मग्रंथों की महत्वपूर्ण शिक्षाओं पर प्रवचन देते हैं और लोगों के जीवन पर उनके प्रभाव पर व्याख्यान देते हैं।.

programme.title: The Zoo
programme.desc: Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals.

programme.title: Earth's Tropical Islands
programme.desc: From the makers of Earth's Greatest Rivers, Earth's Tropical Islands journeys to three of the most exotic, mysterious and remote islands on planet Earth: Madagascar, Borneo and Hawaii. In three episodes, the series reveals how these isolated and iconic tropical islands harbour remarkable wildlife and human castaways found nowhere else on Earth. Madagascar is the oldest island in the world, Borneo cradles more diversity of life than any other island, and Hawaii is the remotest island chain in the world. In a rapidly changing world, these fragile islands are a vital gauge for the health of our planet.

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
programme.desc: Carrying on late wildlife conservationist Steve Irwin's mission to bring people closer to animals is now the mission of his family. Terri, Bindi and Robert Irwin return to Animal Planet, giving viewers access to their wildlife adventures around the world and the amazing animals that continue to inspire their conservation efforts. The series features the family caring for more than 1,200 animals at the Australia Zoo; overseeing a world-class wildlife hospital, the largest of its kind in the world; and conducting high-level global expeditions.

programme.title: Into the Wild: India
programme.desc: A journey into India's wilderness highlighting some of its most iconic creatures and diverse habitats. Ranging from tundra to extreme desert, rainforest to urban jungle which provide varied ecological and geographical areas for species to survive.

programme.title: The Zoo
programme.desc: Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals.

programme.sub-title: Raised by a tribe, a young man sets out to help his lady love rescue an enslaved princess of a kingdom that is ruled by a tyrannical king. In doing so, he soon discovers his true identity
programme.desc: महिष्मती के राज्य में,अपने प्यार को पाने की कोशिश करते हुए, शिवुडू को अपने परिवार और उनकी विरासत के अतीत के बारे में पता चलता है। अब उसे खुद को अपने नए दुश्मन का सामना करने के लिए तैयार करना होगा।.

credits.actor: Prabhas (Amarendra Baahubali / Mahendra Baahubali \"Sivudu\" / \"Sivu\" / Maharaja Veerendra Vikramadeva),Rana Daggubati (Bhallaladeva / Palvaalthevan),Anushka Shetty (Devasena / Devasenai),Tamannaah Bhatia (Avanthika),Nasser (Bijjaladeva / Pingalathevan),Sathyaraj (Karikala Kattappa Nadar),Ramya Krishna (Sivagami Devi),Venkat Prasad,Meka Ramakrishna (Jaya Varma),Subbaraya Sarma,Scarlett Mellish Wilson,Nora Fatehi,Rajababu,Bharani Shankar,Charandeep,Pramilarani,Kalpalatha,Rohini (Sanga)

programme.title: रॉबिनहुड
programme.sub-title: A modern-day Robin Hood thrives on stealing from the rich. However, he reluctantly becomes a bodyguard for a high-profile client due to unforeseen circumstances
programme.desc: आज का रॉबिन हुड अमीरों से चोरी करके खुश होता है। हालाँकि, अप्रत्याशित परिस्थितियों के कारण वह अनिच्छा से एक हाई-प्रोफाइल क्लाइंट का बॉडीगार्ड बन जाता है।.

credits.actor: Shine Tom Chacko (Victor Varghese),Nithiin (Ram / Robinhood 1),Sreeleela (Neera Vasudev),Kyle Paul (Neera Vasudev),Vennela Kishore (Jyothi),Devdatta Nage (Saamy),Subhalekha Sudhakar (Orphanage owner),Brahmaji (Subba Rao)

programme.title: एक्शन
programme.sub-title: Subhash, an army man, seeks vengeance when a conspiracy claims his loved ones. He investigates the plot and takes matters into his own hands, mounting a daring operation to capture the culprit
programme.desc: एक साजिश के तहत एक सैनिक सुभाष के प्रियजनों की हत्या कर दी जाती है, तब वह बदला लेना चाहता है। वह उस साजिश की जाँच करता है और मामले को अपने हाथों में लेकर अपराधी को पकड़ने के साहसिक अभियान जाता है।.

credits.actor: Vishal (Subhash),Tamannaah Bhatia (Diya),Aishwarya Lekshmi (Meera),Ramki (Subash's Brother),Yogi Babu (Jack),Akanksha Puri (Kiara),Chaya Singh (Kayalvizhi),Kabir Duhan Singh (Syed Ibrahim Malik)

programme.title: ऑफिसर ऑन ड्यूटी
programme.sub-title: A demoted cop looks into fake jewelry criminals, getting caught up in a risky world of bad guys, putting his life in danger as he tries to solve the case
programme.desc: एक पदावनत पुलिस अधिकारी नकली आभूषणों से जुड़े अपराधियों की कार्रवाई करता है, जिससे वह बुरे लोगों की जोखिम भरी दुनिया में उलझ जाता है। मामले को सुलझाने के प्रयास में वह अपनी जान जोखिम में डाल देता है।.

programme.title: एनाकोन्डाज: ट्रेल ऑफ ब्लड
programme.sub-title: When an experiment goes wrong, a genetically enhanced anaconda offspring is unleashed. Possessing the power to regenerate, it quickly creates panic and destruction
programme.desc: एक प्रयोग के गलत हो जाने पर आनुवंशिक रूप से बड़े किए गए एनाकोंडा के बच्चे को छोड़ दिया जाता है। पुनर्जनन करने की शक्ति रखने वाला यह एनाकोंडा जल्दी ही आतंक और विनाश का कारण बन जाता है।.

programme.title: बेस्ट ऑफ़ क्राइम पेट्रोल
programme.sub-title: Some of the best cases of 'Crime Patrol', which investigates how innocent people turn into criminals due to the influence of evil in society
programme.desc: कार्यक्रम, 'क्राइम पेट्रोल' में हत्या, अपहरण, धोखाधड़ी और चोरी जैसे कई अपराधों से जुड़ी सच्ची कहानियों को नाट्य रूपांतरण के माध्यम से पेश किया जाता है।.

programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.desc: सेवक, भोला मन ही मन अपने मालिक की पोती से प्यार करता है, जिसकी शादी तय हो चुकी है। लेकिन, दहेज माँगनेवाला दूल्हा, पैसे के साथ फरार हो जाता है और भोला को उसे वापस लाने के लिए भेजा जाता है।.

credits.actor: Dilip Kumar (Bholenath),Saira Banu (Tara),Leena Chandavarkar (Soniya),Prem Chopra (Kuvar Pratap Sinh),Madan Puri (Glasco),Nasir Hussain (Poojary),Helen (Lucy),Kader Khan (Superintendent Of Police)

programme.title: Meraa Dost Meraa Dushman
programme.desc: Two brothers, Shakti and Shaitan Singh, raised by a bandit father, find their lives altered when Shakti is saved by a kind family, sparking a clash of loyalties and family ties.

credits.actor: Shatrughan Sinha,Smita Patil,Geeta Behl,Sanjeev Kumar,Johnny Walker,Danny Denzongpa

programme.title: राज तिलक
programme.sub-title: A king is cheated by his own men and his newborn son ends up in a gypsy camp. Several years later, when a substitute prince, Shamsher, inflicts atrocities on the royal family, the lost prince returns
programme.desc: एक राजा को अपने ही लोग धोखा देते हैं और उसका छोटा लड़का एक बंजारों की छावनी में पहुँच जाता है। कई सालों बाद, जब लोगों पर अत्याचार होता है तब असली राजकुमार अपने परिवार का बदला लेने के लिए लौटता है।.

credits.actor: Dharmendra,Hema Malini,Pran,Raaj Kumar,Sunil Dutt,Reena Roy,Kamal Haasan,Ranjeeta Kaur

programme.title: मन की आँखें
programme.sub-title: Rajesh is in love with his teacher's daughter and marries her in secret as he fears the wrath of his dowry-seeking mother. He hopes his mother will accept his new wife
programme.desc: राजेश अपने शिक्षक की बेटी से प्यार करता है और उससे चुपके से शादी कर लेता है क्योंकि वह अपनी दहेज की लोभी, माँ के गुस्से से डरता है। उसे उम्मीद है कि उसकी माँ उसकी नई पत्नी को स्वीकार करेगी।.

credits.actor: Manmohan Krishna (Master Dinanath),Waheeda Rehmna (Guddi),Dharmendra (Rajesh Agarwal),Sujit Kumar (Naresh Agarwal)

programme.title: आराधना
programme.sub-title: After Arun dies in a plane crash, Vandana gives up her child for adoption as she and Arun married in secret. But, she works as a nanny for the family that adopted her son to stay close to him
programme.desc: विमान दुर्घटना में अरुण की मृत्यु के बाद, वंदना अपने बच्चे को गोद देने के लिए दे देती है। लेकिन, वह उस परिवार के लिए नैनी का काम करती है जिसने उसके बेटे को गोद लिया था ताकि वह उसके करीब रह सके।.

credits.actor: Rajesh Khanna (Arun / Suraj Prasad Saxena),Sharmila Tagore (Vandhana Tripathi),Sujit Kumar (Madan Verma),Farida Jalal (Renu),Anita Dutt (Mrs. Prasad Saxena (Woman in the silhouette)),Madan Puri (Prison Warden),Ashok Kumar (Air Commodore Ganguly),Abhi Bhattacharya (Ram Prasad Saxena),Asit Sen (Sitaram),Manmohan (Shyam)

programme.title: दो अनजाने
programme.sub-title: Amit is found on the railway tracks, mortally wounded and suffering from amnesia, after which a wealthy couple adopts him. However, six years later, he regains his memory after watching a film
programme.desc: एक आदमी घायल होता है और कोमा में जाता है। वह छह साल बाद होश में आता है और उसे पता चलता है कि उसकी याददाश्त चली गयी है। एक फिल्म देखने के बाद, उसकी याददाश्त वापस आती है।.

credits.actor: Amitabh Bachchan,Rekha,Prem Chopra,Pradeep Kumar,Utpal Dutt,Lalita Pawar,Jagdish Raj,Urmila Bhatt,Kanu Roy,Anoop Kumar

programme.title: गहरी चाल
programme.sub-title: When the chairman of a bank commits suicide after embezzling money, his son, Ratan, tries to cover up the secret. However, Shekhar threatens to expose it if he does not help him in a heist
programme.desc: शेखर, रतन से एक लूट में उसकी मदद करने के लिए कहता है, वरना वह उसके छिपे अतीत को बेनकाब करने की धमकी देता है। परेशान होकर रतन, शेखर की मदद करता है, लेकिन वह खुद प्रमुख संदिग्ध बन जाता है।.

programme.desc: పాండా, కోడిపుంజు స్నేహితులై సాంస్కృతిక వైవిధ్యాన్ని ప్రోత్సహిస్తూ, వివిధ దేశాల ఉత్సాహభరితమైన సంస్కృతులను అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: డేంజర్ మౌస్
programme.sub-title: Danger Mouse, a talented secret agent, and his faithful sidekick, Ernest Penfold, do all they can to thwart the evil plans of Baron Silas von Greenback
programme.desc: రహస్య ఏజెంట్ డేంజర్ మౌస్, ఎర్నెస్ట్ పెన్ఫోల్డ్ తో కలిసి గ్రీన్ బ్యాక్ దుష్ట ప్రణాళికలను అడ్డుకోడానికి ప్రత్నిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Alexander Armstrong (Danger Mouse),Dave Lamb,Kevin Eldon (Penfold),Stephen Fry (Colonel K)

programme.title: ఖుషీ రాముడు
programme.sub-title: Rama, together with his siblings and companions, embarks on numerous adventures while undergoing training at Vashist Ashram Gurukul
programme.desc: రాముడు, తన సోదరులు మరియు సహచరులతో కలిసి, వశిష్ఠ ఆశ్రమ గురుకులంలో శిక్షణ పొందుతూ అనేక సాహసయాత్రలను చేపడతాడు.

programme.title: వేక్ అప్ మ్యూజిక్ ఐడీ
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive collection of refreshing songs to help audiences kick-start the day, featuring popular artists and bands
programme.desc: ప్రముఖ కళాకారులు, బ్యాండ్‌ల పాటలతో, శ్రోతలు తమ రోజును ఉత్సాహంగా ప్రారంభించడానికి సహాయపడే ఉత్తేజకరమైన పాటల సమగ్ర సమాహారం.

programme.title: పంచతంత్ర నీతి కథలు
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of stories from the Panchatantra, a collection of Indian fables, that helps to instil morals and values in children
programme.desc: భారతీయ నీతి కథల సమాహారమైన, పంచతంత్ర కథల సమగ్ర సంకలనం, ఇది పిల్లలలో నైతికత, విలువలను పెంపొందించడానికి సహాయపడుతుంది.

programme.title: హ్యాపీ బర్త్ డే
programme.sub-title: Children celebrate their birthdays with a heart-touching note from their loved ones on the occasion of the special memorable day
programme.desc: పిల్లలు తమకు ఎంతో ప్రత్యేకమైన రోజు నాడు, తమ ప్రియమైన వారి నుండి హృదయాన్ని హత్తుకునే సందేశాలతో పుట్టినరోజు జరుపుకుంటారు.

programme.title: సూపర్ సింగూ
programme.desc: Super Singhoo.

programme.title: డోరా ప్రయాణం
programme.sub-title: A seven-year-old courageous girl, Dora, embarks on a trip with her best friend, Boots, in order to find something that interests her
programme.desc: ఏడేళ్ల అమ్మాయి డోరా తనకు ఆసక్తి ఉన్నదాన్ని కనుగొనడానికి తన స్నేహితుడు బూట్స్‌తో కలిసి విహారయాత్రకు బయలుదేరుతుంది.

programme.desc: లిటిల్ హక్కా యానిమేటెడ్ పిల్లల సాహస కథలో ప్రకృతిని బెదిరించే దుష్ట శక్తులతో పోరాడడానికి 'హక్కా టోపీ'ని ఉపయోగిస్తుంది.

credits.actor: Joy Jackson,Alysa Kees,Natasha Kees,George Kees,Scotty Prysko,Brandy Nicole Spohn

programme.title: పాండా మరియు రూస్టర్ సాహసాలు
programme.sub-title: A Panda and a rooster become friends as they set out on exciting adventures to explore the vibrant cultures of various countries while promoting the concept of cultural diversity
programme.desc: పాండా, కోడిపుంజు స్నేహితులై సాంస్కృతిక వైవిధ్యాన్ని ప్రోత్సహిస్తూ, వివిధ దేశాల ఉత్సాహభరితమైన సంస్కృతులను అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: పంచతంత్ర నీతి కథలు
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of stories from the Panchatantra, a collection of Indian fables, that helps to instil morals and values in children
programme.desc: భారతీయ నీతి కథల సమాహారమైన, పంచతంత్ర కథల సమగ్ర సంకలనం, ఇది పిల్లలలో నైతికత, విలువలను పెంపొందించడానికి సహాయపడుతుంది.

programme.title: అకిరా మరియు మోగ్లీ: ది జంగిల్ బుక్ సాహసాలు
programme.desc: Akira Mariyu Mowgli: The Jungle Book Sahasaalu.

programme.title: లిటిల్ కృష్ణ
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna, a mischievous child, lives in the village of Vrindavan. He decides to save the villagers from an evil king, Kamsa, who sends ferocious demons upon them
programme.desc: కొంటెవాడైన చిన్ని కృష్ణుడు, ప్రజలపైకి భయంకర రాక్షసులను పంపిన దుష్ట కంసుడి నుండి బృందావన ప్రజలను కాపాడాలనుకుంటాడు.

credits.actor: Prachi Save Saathi,Meghna Erande,Neil D'Monte,Anand Tiwari,Vikrant Chaturvedi,Soniya Nair,Cara Pareira

programme.title: హైడీ
programme.sub-title: Heidi lives in Frankfurt and has a friend, Clara. However, after spending time at her grandfather's place in the countryside, she yearns to go back and spend time in the open mountain pasture
programme.desc: తన తాతయ్య అల్పోహితో కలిసి ఉండడానికి స్విస్ ఆల్ప్స్ వెళ్లిన హైడీ పట్ల ఆమె తాతయ్య అమితమైన ప్రేమను ఏర్పరచుకుంటాడు.

credits.actor: Kristin Fiedler (Heidi),Thomas Ohrner (Peter),Erik Jelde (Alm-Öhi),Ursula Wolff (Klara),Tilly Lauenstein (Fräulein Rottenmeier),Leon Rainer

programme.title: పంచతంత్ర నీతి కథలు సరి కొత్త
programme.sub-title: Moral-filled tales come to life as engaging characters navigate challenges, teaching lessons on wisdom, honesty and friendship through captivating storytelling
programme.desc: పాత్రలు సవాళ్లను అధిగమించి, జ్ఞానం, నిజాయితీ, స్నేహంపై పాఠాలను బోధించడం ద్వారా నైతికతతో నిండిన కథలు ప్రాణం పోసుకుంటాయి.

programme.title: శక్తిమాన్
programme.sub-title: A young college boy discovers his yogic superpowers and transforms into a superhero who protects the world from an evil villain
programme.desc: ఒక కళాశాల యువకుడు తన శక్తులను కనుగొని ప్రపంచాన్ని ఒక దుష్ట విలన్ నుండి రక్షించే సూపర్ హీరో గా రూపాంతరం చెందుతాడు.

programme.sub-title: A Panda and a rooster become friends as they set out on exciting adventures to explore the vibrant cultures of various countries while promoting the concept of cultural diversity

programme.title: డేంజర్ మౌస్
programme.sub-title: Danger Mouse, a talented secret agent, and his faithful sidekick, Ernest Penfold, do all they can to thwart the evil plans of Baron Silas von Greenback
programme.desc: రహస్య ఏజెంట్ డేంజర్ మౌస్, ఎర్నెస్ట్ పెన్ఫోల్డ్ తో కలిసి గ్రీన్ బ్యాక్ దుష్ట ప్రణాళికలను అడ్డుకోడానికి ప్రత్నిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Alexander Armstrong (Danger Mouse),Dave Lamb,Kevin Eldon (Penfold),Stephen Fry (Colonel K)

programme.title: ఖుషీ రాముడు
programme.sub-title: Rama, together with his siblings and companions, embarks on numerous adventures while undergoing training at Vashist Ashram Gurukul
programme.desc: రాముడు, తన సోదరులు మరియు సహచరులతో కలిసి, వశిష్ఠ ఆశ్రమ గురుకులంలో శిక్షణ పొందుతూ అనేక సాహసయాత్రలను చేపడతాడు.

programme.title: వేక్ అప్ మ్యూజిక్ ఐడీ

programme.desc: రహస్య ఏజెంట్ డేంజర్ మౌస్, ఎర్నెస్ట్ పెన్ఫోల్డ్ తో కలిసి గ్రీన్ బ్యాక్ దుష్ట ప్రణాళికలను అడ్డుకోడానికి ప్రత్నిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Alexander Armstrong (Danger Mouse),Dave Lamb,Kevin Eldon (Penfold),Stephen Fry (Colonel K)

programme.title: ఖుషీ రాముడు
programme.sub-title: Rama, together with his siblings and companions, embarks on numerous adventures while undergoing training at Vashist Ashram Gurukul
programme.desc: రాముడు, తన సోదరులు మరియు సహచరులతో కలిసి, వశిష్ఠ ఆశ్రమ గురుకులంలో శిక్షణ పొందుతూ అనేక సాహసయాత్రలను చేపడతాడు.

programme.title: వేక్ అప్ మ్యూజిక్ ఐడీ
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive collection of refreshing songs to help audiences kick-start the day, featuring popular artists and bands
programme.desc: ప్రముఖ కళాకారులు, బ్యాండ్‌ల పాటలతో, శ్రోతలు తమ రోజును ఉత్సాహంగా ప్రారంభించడానికి సహాయపడే ఉత్తేజకరమైన పాటల సమగ్ర సమాహారం.

programme.title: పంచతంత్ర నీతి కథలు
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of stories from the Panchatantra, a collection of Indian fables, that helps to instil morals and values in children
programme.desc: భారతీయ నీతి కథల సమాహారమైన, పంచతంత్ర కథల సమగ్ర సంకలనం, ఇది పిల్లలలో నైతికత, విలువలను పెంపొందించడానికి సహాయపడుతుంది.

programme.title: హ్యాపీ బర్త్ డే
programme.sub-title: Children celebrate their birthdays with a heart-touching note from their loved ones on the occasion of the special memorable day

programme.title: लिटिल कृष्णा मेलडिज
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna has fun getting caught up in all sorts of mischief with his friends in Vrindavan. But when the evil Kansa sends his minions to disrupt his life, he jumps into action
programme.desc: नन्हे कृष्ण वृंदावन में अपने दोस्तों के साथ तरह-तरह की शरारतें करते हुए मज़े करते हैं। लेकिन जब दुष्ट कंस उनके जीवन में खलल डालने के लिए अपने अनुचर भेजता है, तब वे तुरंत हरकत में आ जाते हैं।.

programme.title: लिटिल कृष्ण
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna, a mischievous child, lives in the village of Vrindavan. He decides to save the villagers from an evil king, Kamsa, who sends ferocious demons upon them
programme.desc: एक शरारती बच्चा छोटा कृष्ण वृंदावन गाँव में रहता है। वह क्रूर राक्षसों को ग्रामीणों पर हमला के लिए भेजने वाले एक दुष्ट राजा, कंस से उन्हें बचाने का फैसला करता है।.

credits.actor: Prachi Save Saathi,Meghna Erande,Neil D'Monte,Anand Tiwari,Vikrant Chaturvedi,Soniya Nair,Cara Pareira

programme.sub-title: Bheem and his friends are excited to attend a fair. However, things take a sudden turn when some evil entities release a powerful demon known as Vinaash Beej
programme.desc: मेले में जाने के लिए उत्साहित भीम और उसके दोस्तों के साथ चीजें तब अचानक बदल जाती हैं जब कुछ बुरी संस्थाएँ विनाश बीज नामक एक शक्तिशाली राक्षस को छोड़ देती हैं।.

programme.title: ग्रिजी एण्ड द लेम्मिंग्स
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: ग्रिज़ी नामक भालू, हर बार जब वन रेंजर घर छोड़ता है तो उसके घर में रहता है और उसे अपना घर मानता है। हालाँकि, जब लेमिंग्स की एक जनजाति उसी घर में रहने आती है तो चीजें बदल जाती हैं।.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.title: लिटिल कृष्णा मेलडिज
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna has fun getting caught up in all sorts of mischief with his friends in Vrindavan. But when the evil Kansa sends his minions to disrupt his life, he jumps into action
programme.desc: नन्हे कृष्ण वृंदावन में अपने दोस्तों के साथ तरह-तरह की शरारतें करते हुए मज़े करते हैं। लेकिन जब दुष्ट कंस उनके जीवन में खलल डालने के लिए अपने अनुचर भेजता है, तब वे तुरंत हरकत में आ जाते हैं।.

programme.title: लिटिल कृष्ण
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna, a mischievous child, lives in the village of Vrindavan. He decides to save the villagers from an evil king, Kamsa, who sends ferocious demons upon them
programme.desc: एक शरारती बच्चा छोटा कृष्ण वृंदावन गाँव में रहता है। वह क्रूर राक्षसों को ग्रामीणों पर हमला के लिए भेजने वाले एक दुष्ट राजा, कंस से उन्हें बचाने का फैसला करता है।.

credits.actor: Prachi Save Saathi,Meghna Erande,Neil D'Monte,Anand Tiwari,Vikrant Chaturvedi,Soniya Nair,Cara Pareira

programme.title: छोटा भीम दमयान की दहशत
programme.sub-title: Chhota Bheem and his friends visit Sagarpur on King Indravarma's orders. The gang fights monsters in order to protect the Jal Chakra, but things change when Damyaan makes an appearance
programme.desc: राजा इंद्रवर्मा खतरे को भांपते हुए छोटा भीम और उसके दोस्तों को सागरपुर भेज देते हैं। वहाँ उन्हें पता चलता है, कि जल चक्र की रक्षा करने और दमयान को हराने के लिए उन्हें पानी को हराना सीखना होगा।.

programme.title: युद्धकाल
programme.sub-title: Kaal kidnaps Little Singham's parents to steal their power and use it to execute his wicked schemes. Later, he learns that he must encounter three different challenges to save his parents
programme.desc: काल लिटिल सिंघम के माता-पिता की शक्तियों को चुराने के लिए उनका अपहरण कर लेता है। वहीं लिटिल सिंघम अपने माता-पिता को बचाने के लिए तीन अलग-अलग चुनौतियों का सामना करता है।.

programme.title: एलएस राइज़ ऑफ काल वंश
programme.sub-title: As evil forces set forth to wreak havoc on earth, Little Singham, joined by his loyal friends, band together to save the planet
programme.desc: एक युवा लेकिन कठोर पुलिसकर्मी लिटिल सिंघम, ग्रह की भलाई के लिए खतरा पैदा करने वाली शैतानी ताकतों को हराने के लिए अपने दोस्तों के समूह के साथ एक साहसिक अभियान पर निकलता है।.

programme.title: एलएस 3डी नाग सिंघम सर्पकाल का वार (एलएस बर्थडे)
programme.sub-title: As the evil Kaal prepares to capture the world of snakes, Little Singham turns into a snake-person so he can challenge Kaal and foil his mission

programme.title: छोटा भीम
programme.sub-title: Bheem is an extremely brave, strong and intelligent young boy. He often manages to solve everyone's problems which endears him to the townspeople of Dholakpur
programme.desc: भीम एक असाधारण, शक्तिशाली और बुद्धिमान लड़का है। गाँव के सभी बच्चे उसे पसंद करते हैं, क्योंकि वह सभी की समस्याओं को हल करने में उनकी मदद करता है।.

credits.actor: Vatsal Dubey (Chhota Bheem),Julie Tejwani (Raju),Rupa Bhimani (Chutki),Sabina Malik Mausam (Kalia),Rajesh Kava (Jaggu),Prince Patel (Takiya)

programme.title: छोटा भीम: द क्यूरियस केस ऑफ स्वैप्ड सोल्स
programme.sub-title: To seize the kids' souls, Anira swaps Bheem and his friends' souls with one another. Limited in their powers while swapped, Bheem and his team must find the source of Anira's powers to undo the spell
programme.desc: बच्चों की आत्माओं को कब्ज़े में करने के लिए अनिरा भीम और उसके दोस्तों की आत्माओं की अदला-बदली करती है। आत्माएं बदलने के कारण शक्तियां सीमित होने पर, भीम और उसकी टीम को शक्तियों के स्रोत को खोजना होगा।.

programme.title: छोटा भीम - द जर्नी टू जीवलोक, पार्ट 1
programme.sub-title: Rival clans battle over a magical infant from Jeevlok whom Bheem discovers during an assault by Kaalvigna. Consequently, Bheem travels to Shantisthal to secure global harmony
programme.desc: कालविघ्न के हमले के दौरान भीम को जीवलोक के एक जादुई शिशु के बारे में पता चलता है, जिसके लिए विरोधी गुट आपस में लड़ते हैं। इसके बाद, दुनिया में शांति बनाए रखने के लिए भीम शांतिस्थल की यात्रा करता है।.

programme.title: छोटा भीम द जर्नी टू जीवलोक पार्ट 02
programme.sub-title: While searching for Raju and Chutki, Bheem loses Baby Ankur to Kaalvigna's deception. Later, Bheem must unite the Vanaspati Yodhas and Pashu Raj to defeat this dark evil once and for all
programme.desc: राजू और छुटकी की तलाश के दौरान, भीम कालविघ्न के छल में आकर बेबी अंकुर को खो देता है। बाद में, भीम को इस काले अंधेरे को हमेशा के लिए हराने के लिए वनस्पति योद्धाओं और पशु राज को एकजुट करना होगा।.

programme.title: छोटा भीम मास्टर ऑफ शाओलिन
programme.sub-title: Chota Bheem teams up with Ming, a monk, to help him fight against the evil Kaifu who does everything in his power to take over the Shaolin temple
programme.desc: छोटा भीम, मिंग नामक एक भिक्षु के साथ मिलकर दुष्ट कैफू के खिलाफ लड़ने में मदद करता है, जो शाओलिन मंदिर पर कब्जा करने के लिए अपनी पूरी ताकत लगा देता है।.

credits.actor: Sonal Kaushal,Rupa Bhimani,Julie Tejwani,Rajesh Kava,Sabina Malik Mausam,Jigna Bhardwaj

programme.title: लिटिल कृष्णा मेलडिज
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna has fun getting caught up in all sorts of mischief with his friends in Vrindavan. But when the evil Kansa sends his minions to disrupt his life, he jumps into action
programme.desc: नन्हे कृष्ण वृंदावन में अपने दोस्तों के साथ तरह-तरह की शरारतें करते हुए मज़े करते हैं। लेकिन जब दुष्ट कंस उनके जीवन में खलल डालने के लिए अपने अनुचर भेजता है, तब वे तुरंत हरकत में आ जाते हैं।.

programme.title: लिटिल कृष्ण
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna, a mischievous child, lives in the village of Vrindavan. He decides to save the villagers from an evil king, Kamsa, who sends ferocious demons upon them
programme.desc: एक शरारती बच्चा छोटा कृष्ण वृंदावन गाँव में रहता है। वह क्रूर राक्षसों को ग्रामीणों पर हमला के लिए भेजने वाले एक दुष्ट राजा, कंस से उन्हें बचाने का फैसला करता है।.

credits.actor: Prachi Save Saathi,Meghna Erande,Neil D'Monte,Anand Tiwari,Vikrant Chaturvedi,Soniya Nair,Cara Pareira

programme.title: आरआरआर लिटिल सिंघम एण्ड छोटा भीम इन पुलिस अकैडमी
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्यक्रमों की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: छोटा भीम और लिटिल सिंघम दो का दम पार्ट 01
programme.sub-title: Chhota Bheem and Little Singham join forces to defeat the rising evil with their tactics and bring back happiness to their lands
programme.desc: छोटा भीम और लिटिल सिंघम अपनी रणनीति से बढ़ती बुराई को हराने और अपने देश में खुशियाँ वापस लाने के लिए एकजुट होते हैं।.

programme.title: छोटा भीम और लिटिल सिंघम दो का दम पार्ट 02
programme.sub-title: Chhota Bheem and Little Singham join forces to safeguard 'Pari Mani', a precious and pious gem, and battle against the evil forces
programme.desc: छोटा भीम और लिटिल सिंघम एक बहुमूल्य और पवित्र रत्न 'परी मणि' की रक्षा करने और बुरी शक्तियों के खिलाफ लड़ने के लिए एकजुट होते हैं।.

programme.title: लिटिल सिंघम: समुद्र काल से संग्राम
programme.sub-title: Little Singham embarks on a perilous mission to thwart the devious plan of an adversary, overcoming numerous challenges to safeguard the marine ecosystem
programme.desc: लिटिल सिंघम एक दुश्मन की कुटिल योजना को विफल करने के लिए खतरनाक मिशन पर निकलता है, तथा समुद्री पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र की सुरक्षा के लिए कई चुनौतियों का सामना करता है।.

programme.title: लिटिल सिंघम - कन्स और काल का राज
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविज़न के एक से बढ़कर एक कार्यक्रमों को प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।.

programme.title: रिटर्न ऑफ लिटिल सिंघम
programme.sub-title: Little Singham, a brave and young police officer, sets out on epic adventures and fights against various evil entities in order to protect his city
programme.desc: लिटिल सिंघम, एक बहादुर और युवा पुलिस अधिकारी, अपने शहर की रक्षा के लिए साहसिक कार्य पर निकलता है और विभिन्न बुरी शक्तियों के खिलाफ लड़ता है।.

programme.title: ग्रिजी एण्ड द लेम्मिंग्स
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: ग्रिज़ी नामक भालू, हर बार जब वन रेंजर घर छोड़ता है तो उसके घर में रहता है और उसे अपना घर मानता है। हालाँकि, जब लेमिंग्स की एक जनजाति उसी घर में रहने आती है तो चीजें बदल जाती हैं।.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.title: स्मैशिंग सिम्बा
programme.sub-title: Simmba, an honest and courageous police officer, teams up with his fearless colleagues in his mission to confront and defeat the evil forces of society
programme.desc: सिम्बा, एक ईमानदार और साहसी पुलिस अधिकारी, अपने निडर सहयोगियों के साथ मिलकर समाज की बुरी ताकतों का सामना करने और उन्हें हराने के मिशन पर निकलता है।.

programme.title: स्मैशिंग सिम्बा
programme.sub-title: Upon learning of Michael Money's sinister plan to steal the town's funds, Simmba leaps into action to stop him from executing the robbery
programme.desc: सिम्बा, एक ईमानदार और साहसी पुलिस अधिकारी, अपने निडर सहयोगियों के साथ मिलकर समाज की बुरी ताकतों का सामना करने और उन्हें हराने के मिशन पर निकलता है।.

programme.title: स्मैशिंग सिम्बा
programme.sub-title: During a confrontation, Duggu Dumbbell challenges Simmba to three different strength contests to determine who is more powerful
programme.desc: सिम्बा, एक ईमानदार और साहसी पुलिस अधिकारी, अपने निडर सहयोगियों के साथ मिलकर समाज की बुरी ताकतों का सामना करने और उन्हें हराने के मिशन पर निकलता है।.

programme.sub-title: When Kittu gets stuck while trying to solve a case, she goes to Simmba for help. But when Simmba shows no interest in wanting to help her, she takes it as a challenge to solve the case on her own
programme.desc: सिम्बा, एक ईमानदार और साहसी पुलिस अधिकारी, अपने निडर सहयोगियों के साथ मिलकर समाज की बुरी ताकतों का सामना करने और उन्हें हराने के मिशन पर निकलता है।.

programme.title: लिटिल कृष्णा मेलडिज
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna has fun getting caught up in all sorts of mischief with his friends in Vrindavan. But when the evil Kansa sends his minions to disrupt his life, he jumps into action
programme.desc: नन्हे कृष्ण वृंदावन में अपने दोस्तों के साथ तरह-तरह की शरारतें करते हुए मज़े करते हैं। लेकिन जब दुष्ट कंस उनके जीवन में खलल डालने के लिए अपने अनुचर भेजता है, तब वे तुरंत हरकत में आ जाते हैं।.

programme.title: लिटिल कृष्ण
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna, a mischievous child, lives in the village of Vrindavan. He decides to save the villagers from an evil king, Kamsa, who sends ferocious demons upon them
programme.desc: एक शरारती बच्चा छोटा कृष्ण वृंदावन गाँव में रहता है। वह क्रूर राक्षसों को ग्रामीणों पर हमला के लिए भेजने वाले एक दुष्ट राजा, कंस से उन्हें बचाने का फैसला करता है।.

credits.actor: Prachi Save Saathi,Meghna Erande,Neil D'Monte,Anand Tiwari,Vikrant Chaturvedi,Soniya Nair,Cara Pareira

programme.title: ग्रिजी एण्ड द लेम्मिंग्स
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: ग्रिज़ी नामक भालू, हर बार जब वन रेंजर घर छोड़ता है तो उसके घर में रहता है और उसे अपना घर मानता है। हालाँकि, जब लेमिंग्स की एक जनजाति उसी घर में रहने आती है तो चीजें बदल जाती हैं।.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.title: सर्वाइविंग द सेरेंगेटी
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker sheds light on how a famine turns into a feast for the insatiable predatory inhabitants of the Serengeti National Park when many animals visit the park during migration season
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार इस बात पर प्रकाश डालते हैं, कि कैसे सेरेंगेटी नेशनल पार्क के अतृप्त शिकारी निवासियों के लिए अकाल एक दावत में बदल जाता है, जब कई जानवर प्रवास के मौसम में पार्क में आते हैं।.

programme.title: वाइल्ड तंजानिया
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker explores the wilderness of Tanzania and sheds light on the different types of wildlife living in the region
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार तंजानिया के जंगलों का अन्वेषण करते हैं और इस क्षेत्र में रहने वाले विभिन्न प्रकार के वन्य जीवन पर प्रकाश डालते हैं।.

programme.title: ब्रदरहुड ऑफ लायन्स
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker delves into the fascinating life of five young lions residing in the Masai Mara reserve in Kenya while highlighting the threats they face such as poaching and habitat loss
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार केन्या के मसाई मारा रिजर्व में रहने वाले पाँच युवा शेरों के जीवन पर प्रकाश डालते हैं, साथ ही वे उनके द्वारा सामना किए जा रहे शिकार और आवास का नुकसान जैसे कई खतरों पर भी प्रकाश डालते हैं।.

programme.title: हिप्पोस आफ्टर डार्क
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker captures the extreme power play and struggle for survival between a pride of lions and a herd of hippos under the protection of a ferocious bull as night falls
programme.desc: फिल्म निर्माता रात के समय एक खूंखार बैल के संरक्षण में शेरों के एक समूह और दरियाई घोड़ों के एक झुंड के बीच चरम शक्ति-खेल और अस्तित्व के लिए संघर्ष को फिल्म में दर्शाते हैं।.

programme.title: दी एनिमल विदिन
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker puts a spotlight on wild animals that possess extraordinary abilities and have mastered the art of survival over the course of their evolution
programme.desc: फ़िल्मकार उन जंगली जानवरों पर प्रकाश डालते हैं, जिनमें असाधारण क्षमताएं हैं और जिन्होंने अपने विकास के दौरान जीवित रहने की कला में महारत हासिल कर ली है।.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: नेकेड एण्ड अफ्रेड
programme.sub-title: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well
programme.desc: अजनबियों के कई जोड़ों को सुनसान और ख़तरनाक जंगलों में खूँखार वन्यजीवों से बचते हुए निर्वस्त्र रहकर सिर्फ दो चीज़ों की मदद से जीवित रहने की चुनौती को पूरा करना होगा।.

credits.actor: Michael Brown,Laura Zerra,Fernando Calderón,Amber Hargrove,Jim Morton

programme.title: नेकेड एण्ड अफ्रेड
programme.sub-title: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well
programme.desc: अजनबियों के कई जोड़ों को सुनसान और ख़तरनाक जंगलों में खूँखार वन्यजीवों से बचते हुए निर्वस्त्र रहकर सिर्फ दो चीज़ों की मदद से जीवित रहने की चुनौती को पूरा करना होगा।.

credits.actor: Michael Brown,Laura Zerra,Fernando Calderón,Amber Hargrove,Jim Morton

programme.title: నేకెడ్ అండ్ అఫ్రైడ్
programme.sub-title: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well
programme.desc: తీవ్ర వాతావరణంలో భయపడకుండా అరణ్యంలోని ప్రమాదకరమైన వన్యప్రాణుల నుండి బయటపడటానికి అపరిచితులు జత కడతారు.

credits.actor: Michael Brown,Laura Zerra,Fernando Calderón,Amber Hargrove,Jim Morton

programme.title: నేకెడ్ అండ్ అఫ్రైడ్
programme.sub-title: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well
programme.desc: తీవ్ర వాతావరణంలో భయపడకుండా అరణ్యంలోని ప్రమాదకరమైన వన్యప్రాణుల నుండి బయటపడటానికి అపరిచితులు జత కడతారు.

credits.actor: Michael Brown,Laura Zerra,Fernando Calderón,Amber Hargrove,Jim Morton

programme.title: आचार्य बालकृषण जी

programme.title: योगऋषि स्वामी रामदेवजी महाराज
programme.sub-title: Baba Ramdev, a spiritual leader, delivers a discourse on spirituality and demonstrates various yoga asanas that enable oneself to lead a healthy and active lifestyle
programme.desc: आध्यात्मिक गुरु बाबा रामदेव आध्यात्मिकता पर प्रवचन देते हैं और विभिन्न योग आसनों का प्रदर्शन करते हैं जो स्वस्थ और सक्रिय जीवनशैली जीने में सक्षम बनाते हैं।.

programme.title: विनोद अग्रवाल

programme.title: रवीश मिश्रा जी

programme.title: शीतल पांडे

programme.title: पूज्य ध्यान मूर्ति जी
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on various teachings and practices, while encouraging followers to embrace the path of spirituality
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक गुरु विभिन्न शिक्षाओं और पद्धतियों पर प्रकाश डालते हैं, और साथ ही अपने अनुयायियों को आध्यात्मिकता के मार्ग को अपनाने के लिए प्रेरित करते हैं।.

programme.title: भजन
programme.sub-title: An engaging compilation of spiritual hymns and divine melodies presented by renowned devotional singers from across the globe
programme.desc: दुनिया भर के प्रसिद्ध भक्ति गायकों द्वारा प्रस्तुत आध्यात्मिक भजनों और दिव्य धुनों का एक आकर्षक संकलन की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: स्वामी हरि चैतन्य महाप्रभु जी
programme.sub-title: A spiritual leader enlightens devotees with profound discourses on spirituality, guiding them toward a path of faith, inner peace as well as the essence of righteous living
programme.desc: एक आध्यात्मिक पथप्रदर्शक आध्यात्मिकता पर गहन प्रवचनों के माध्यम से भक्तों को ज्ञान प्रदान करते हैं, तथा उन्हें विश्वास, आंतरिक शांति तथा धार्मिक जीवन जीने के सार की ओर मार्गदर्शन करते हैं।.

programme.title: ப்ரேயர் டைம்
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and shares valuable lessons from various scriptures, encouraging followers to walk the path of spirituality
programme.desc: ஒரு மதத் தலைவர் சர்வவல்லவரின் போதனைகளை வெளிச்சம் போட்டுக் காட்டி, பக்தர்களை ஆன்மீகப் பாதையில் நடக்க ஊக்குவிக்கிறார்.

programme.title: பிரதர் ராஜன்
programme.sub-title: A religious scholar delivers a spiritual discourse on the importance of leading a righteous life and discusses the significance of devotion
programme.desc: மத அறிஞர் நேர்மையான வாழ்க்கை நடத்துவதன் முக்கியத்துவம் மற்றும் பக்தியின் முக்கியத்துவத்தை பற்றி பிரசங்கிக்கிறார்.

programme.title: டாக்டர் ஆனந்த் ஸ்திரா
programme.sub-title: A religious leader shares the message of God, emphasising His importance in guiding humanity and urging followers to embrace spirituality
programme.desc: கடவுளின் செய்தியை பகிர்ந்து, மனிதகுலத்தை அவர் வழிநடத்துவது பற்றி விளக்கி, ஆன்மீகத்தை தழுவுமாறு வலியுறுத்தும் மத தலைவர்.

programme.title: பாஸ்டர் ஃப்ராங்க்ளின்
programme.sub-title: A religious leader delivers a discourse on the teachings of the Holy Bible and encourages followers to embrace the path of spirituality
programme.desc: ஒரு மதத் தலைவர்பைபிளின் போதனைகள் குறித்து ஒரு சொற்பொழிவை நிகழ்த்தி, ஆன்மீக பாதையைத் தழுவுமாறு பக்தர்களை ஊக்குவிக்கிறார்.

programme.title: இன் டச் மினிஸ்ட்ரீஸ்
programme.sub-title: A religious leader delivers a discourse and recites verses from the Holy Bible, encouraging devotees to lead a righteous life
programme.desc: ஒரு மதத் தலைவர் பிரசங்கத்தை வழங்கி, பைபிளிலிருந்து வசனங்களை படித்து, பக்தர்களை நேர்மையான வாழ்க்கையை வாழ ஊக்குவிக்கிறார்.

programme.title: டாக்டர் ஜான் அங்கர்பர்க்
programme.sub-title: Dr John Ankerberg, an expert, shares the message of Christianity and encourages devotees to follow the teachings of the divine
programme.desc: கிறிஸ்தவத்தின் செய்தியை பகிர்ந்து, தெய்வீக போதனைகளை பின்பற்ற பக்தர்களை ஊக்குவிக்கும் நிபுணரான டாக்டர் ஜான் ஆங்கர்பர்க்.

programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of some of the most popular songs produced by renowned artists is played to enthrall the audience
programme.desc: புகழ்பெற்ற கலைஞர்களால் தயாரிக்கப்பட்ட சில பிரபலமான பாடல்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு பார்வையாளர்களைக் கவர இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: பெருமாள் சுப்ரபாதம்
programme.sub-title: A curated compilation of sacred hymns and religious songs in devotion and praise of the Lord Perumal is played back to back
programme.desc: பெருமாளின் பக்தி மற்றும் புகழுடன் கூடிய புனிதமான பாடல்கள் மற்றும் மத பாடல்களின் தொகுக்கப்பட்ட தொகுப்பு இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: கந்த சஷ்டி
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of hymns and Hindu devotional songs praising Lord Muruga played back-to-back seeking his blessings
programme.desc: முருகப்பெருமானை போற்றும் இந்து பக்தி பாடல்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு மற்றும் அவரது ஆசிகளை கோரி தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்பட்டது.

programme.title: கந்த குரு கவச்சம்
programme.sub-title: A religious leader provides a detailed discourse on various spiritual teachings to devotees and encourages them to lead a faithful life
programme.desc: பக்தர்களுக்கு பல ஆன்மீக போதனைகள் பற்றிய சொற்பொழிவை வழங்கி, விசுவாசமான வாழ்க்கையை வாழ அவர்களை ஊக்குவிக்கும் மதத் தலைவர்.

programme.title: மனம் தேடும் ஆலயம்
programme.sub-title: Explore the history and cultural significance of various Hindu temples, the profound symbolism of revered deities and spiritual concepts
programme.desc: பல்வேறு இந்து கோவில்களின் வரலாறு மற்றும் கலாச்சார முக்கியத்துவம், போற்றப்படும் தெய்வங்களின் ஆழ்ந்த குறியீடுகள் மற்றும் ஆன்மீகக் கருத்துக்கள் குறித்து ஆராய்ந்து பாருங்கள்.

programme.title: டெலி ஷாப்பிங் / சினி மினி

programme.title: டெலி ஷாப்பிங் / சினிமா சினிமா
programme.sub-title: The host talks about various products that can be bought from home. The host reviews the latest movie releases from the Kannada film industry and discusses topics that concern cinemagoers

programme.title: டெலி ஷாப்பிங் / திரைக் கதம்பம்
programme.sub-title: Various products are showcased from multiple brands for customers to buy from the comfort of their homes; a curated collection of popular movie scenes

programme.desc: వ్యాఖ్యాత నటుడు నందమూరి బాలకృష్ణతో తన చిత్రం 'డాకు మహారాజ్' గురించి, అతని అనుభవాల గురించి తెలుసుకోవడానికి మాట్లాడతారు.

programme.title: డ్రింకర్ సాయి ప్రెస్ మీట్
programme.sub-title: The cast and crew of the Indian movie 'Drinker Sai' come together to promote their film and share their experiences on the set
programme.desc: ప్రెస్ మీట్‌లో జర్నలిస్టులు అడిగిన ప్రశ్నలకు 'డ్రింకర్ సాయి' సినిమా నటీనటులు, సిబ్బంది ఆన్‌సెట్ అనుభవాలను పంచుకున్నారు.

programme.title: సంక్రాంతికి వస్తున్నాం ట్రైలర్ లాంచ్
programme.sub-title: The actors and makers of 'Sankranthiki Vasthunam' film gather to officially launch the trailer of the film and share their experiences of working on the project
programme.desc: 'సంక్రాంతికి వస్తున్నాం' చిత్ర నటీనటులు, దర్శకుడు సినిమా ట్రైలర్‌ను అధికారికంగా విడుదల చేసి వారి అనుభవాలను పంచుకుంటారు.

programme.title: డాకు మహారాజ్ యూఎస్ఏ ఈవెంట్
programme.sub-title: The cast and crew of 'Daaku Maharaja' share their on-set experiences at the grand pre-release event of the film held in the USA
programme.desc: యుఎస్‌ఎలో జరిగిన గ్రాండ్ ప్రీ-రిలీజ్ ఈవెంట్‌లో 'డాకు మహారాజ్' నటీనటులు, సిబ్బంది తమ ఆన్‌సెట్ అనుభవాలను పంచుకున్నారు.

programme.title: గేమ్ ఛేంజర్ బాంబే ప్రెస్ మీట్
programme.sub-title: The cast and crew of the Indian Telugu-language movie 'Game Changer' get together to promote the project and share their experiences of working on the movie
programme.desc: తెలుగు సినిమా 'గేమ్ ఛేంజర్' తారాగణం, సిబ్బంది తమ సినిమా ప్రచారంలో భాగంగా తమ చిత్రీకరణ అనుభవాలు పంచుకుంటారు.

programme.title: గౌతమ్ 3.0 ఇంటర్వ్యూ

programme.title: సీక్వెల్ ట్రెండ్స్

programme.title: தெய்வீக ராகம்

programme.title: வேக்கப் தமிழா

programme.title: பிரேக்ஃபாஸ்ட் டியூன்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive collection of soul-stirring melodies from the latest Tamil movies featuring renowned artists and musicians, played back to back

programme.title: ப்ரேக்ஃப்ரீ சாங்க்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of songs from Tamil movies, showcasing a diverse range of music to elevate the mood of listeners
programme.desc: தமிழ் திரைப்படப் பாடல்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு, கேட்போரின் மனநிலையை உயர்த்த பல்வேறு வகையான இசையைக் காட்டுகிறது.

programme.title: என்றும் புன்னகை லைவ்

programme.title: ரிலீஜியஸ் ப்ரோக்ராம்
programme.sub-title: A religious leader delivers a discourse on the teachings of the Almighty to enlighten the devotees and guide them on a path of spiritual growth
programme.desc: மத தலைவர் பக்தர்களுக்கு அறிவூட்டவும், ஆன்மீக பாதையில் வழிநடத்தவும் தேவனின் போதனைகள் குறித்த சொற்பொழிவை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.title: சுப்ரபாதம்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional songs and hymns in praise of the divine written by various artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கலைஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட தெய்வீகத்தைப் போற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்கள் மேலும் கீர்த்தனைகள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: கந்தசஷ்டிக்கவசம்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of religious hymns and devotional songs in praise of Lord Murugan written by various artists
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கலைஞர்களால் எழுதப்பட்ட அப்பன் முருகனைப் புகழ்ந்து மத பாடல்கள் மற்றும் பக்தி பாடல்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு.

programme.title: தினம் தினம் தரிசனம்
programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the religious and spiritual significance of various Hindu temples and pilgrimage shrines across India
programme.desc: இந்தியா முழுவதும் உள்ள பல்வேறு இந்து கோவில்கள் மற்றும் புனித யாத்திரை தலங்களின் மத மற்றும் ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவம்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு சஹஸ்ரநாமம்
programme.sub-title: Hindu religious leaders and devotees chant a Sanskrit hymn listing the 1,000 names of Lord Vishnu to seek his divine blessings
programme.desc: இந்து மதத் தலைவர்களும் பக்தர்களும் விஷ்ணுவின் 1,000 நாமங்களைக் கொண்ட சமஸ்கிருத பாடலைப் பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: ஜி‌கே‌பி / பி‌பி / டி‌டி‌எல்‌எம்
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: தொலைக்காட்சியில் சிறந்ததைக் கொண்டுவருதல்.

programme.title: மதுரை காளியம்மன்
programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees gather at a pious shrine to offer their sincere prayers, worship the Almighty and seek divine blessings
programme.desc: பூசாரிகளும் பக்தர்களும் சன்னதியில் கூடி தங்கள் பிரார்த்தனைகளை வழங்கி, இறைவனை வணங்கி, தெய்வீக ஆசீகளைப் பெறுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: விஷ்ணு ஷேத்திரம்
programme.sub-title: Priests and devotees assemble to perform a ceremonial ritual, offering worship and seeking the divine blessings of Lord Vishnu
programme.desc: பூசாரிகளும் பக்தர்களும் கூடி, ஒரு சடங்கு சடங்கை செய்து, வழிபாடு செய்து, விஷ்ணுவின் தெய்வீக ஆசீர்வாதத்தைப் பெறுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: பக்தி பாடல்கள்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of popular devotional songs in praise of deities performed by eminent artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: புகழ்பெற்ற கலைஞர்களால் நடத்தப்படும் தெய்வங்களைப் போற்றும் பிரபலமான பக்திப் பாடல்கள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: சத்குரு
programme.sub-title: Sadhguru, a spiritual guru, gives a discourse on the teachings from the scriptures and urges his followers to walk on the path of righteousness
programme.desc: வேதங்களிலிருந்து போதனைகள் பற்றிய சொற்பொழிவை வழங்கி, பக்தர்களை நீதியின் பாதையில் செல்ல தூண்டும் ஆன்மீக குருவான சத்குரு.

programme.title: ஸ்ரீமத் பாகவதம்
programme.sub-title: A Hindu priest from Tirumala explains the chapters from Bhagavata Purana to the devotees of Lord Krishna in a detailed manner
programme.desc: ஆன்மீகத் தலைவர் ஆழ்ந்த ஞானத்தைப் பகிர்ந்து இந்து கடவுளான கிருஷ்ணரின் வாழ்க்கையை விவரிக்கும் தகவல் உரையை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.title: அம்மன் கோவில்கள்
programme.sub-title: The host sheds light on the religious and cultural significance of various temples and shrines dedicated to Goddess Amman
programme.desc: தேவி அம்மனுக்கான பல்வேறு கோவில்கள் மற்றும் சன்னதிகளின் மத மற்றும் கலாச்சார முக்கியத்துவத்தை எடுத்துக்காட்டுகிறது.

programme.title: இஷ்ட தெய்வம்
programme.sub-title: Renowned individuals extensively discuss their faith and share experiences of divine providence and miracles in their personal lives
programme.desc: தங்கள் நம்பிக்கையை பற்றி பேசுவதோடு, அவர்களின் வாழ்வில் தெய்வீக நம்பிக்கை-அற்புதங்கள் பற்றிய அனுபவங்களை பகிரும் நபர்கள்.

programme.title: சிவாலயம்

programme.sub-title: A religious speaker delivers a discourse on Christian teachings from the Holy Bible, highlighting sacred verses and explaining their significance to the faithful
programme.desc: கர்த்தர் இயேசு மீதான நம்பிக்கை மற்றும் நற்செய்திகள் புனித பைபிளிலிருந்து சொற்பொழிவை வழங்கும் பாதிரியர் ப்ருஸ் ஆலன்.

programme.title: மணவாட்டியே ஆயத்தப்பாடு
programme.sub-title: Sadhu Sundar Selvaraj delivers a religious discourse for brides who are getting ready to meet the Almighty and guides them towards spirituality
programme.desc: கடவுளை சந்திக்கத் தயாராகி வரும் மணப்பெண்களுக்காக பிரசங்கிப்பதோடு, ஆன்மீகத்தை நோக்கி வழிநடத்தும் சாது சுந்தர் செல்வராஜ்.

programme.title: டூ விட்‌நெஸ்
programme.sub-title: A Christian religious leader delivers a discourse on the arrival of the two witnesses mentioned in the Book of Revelation from the Bible
programme.desc: பைபிளிலிருந்து வெளிப்படுத்தல் புத்தகத்தில் குறிப்பிட்டுள்ள இரு சாட்சிகளின் வருகையை பிரசங்கிக்கும் கிறிஸ்தவ மத தலைவர்.

programme.title: ஜேஜேபெளின் மர்மங்கள்
programme.sub-title: A religious scholar provides a comprehensive and detailed insight into the Biblical character, Jezebel, and unravels the mysteries surrounding her
programme.desc: பைபிள் கதாபாத்திரமான ஜேஜேபெளை பற்றிய விரிவான நுண்ணறிவை வழங்குவதோடு, அவளை சுற்றியுள்ள மர்மங்களை அவிழ்க்கும் மத அறிஞர்.

programme.title: அன்பரின் சத்தம்
programme.sub-title: A revered religious leader reads sacred scriptures from the Holy Bible, sharing divine wisdom to strengthen devotees' connection with the Almighty
programme.desc: பரிசுத்த பைபிளிலிருந்து வசனங்களை வசித்து, கடவுளின் அன்பு மற்றும் அவரின் கருணையைப் பற்றி பேசும் ஒரு மதப் போதகர்.

programme.title: இன்னிசை விருந்து
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of several prayers, hymns and religious songs, sung by a group of followers in praise of Jesus Christ
programme.desc: பல பிரார்த்தனைகள், பாடல்கள் மற்றும் மத பாடல்களின் தொகுப்பு, இயேசு கிறிஸ்துவை துதித்து பக்தர்களின் குழுவால் பாடப்பட்டது.

programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथ-प्रदर्शक सर्वशक्तिमान की शिक्षाओं पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और अनुयायियों को आध्यात्मिकता का मार्ग अपनाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: आनंदमय कीर्तन
programme.sub-title: Hindu religious leaders and devotees sing hymns and devotional songs and recite sacred verses to seek the blessings of the Almighty
programme.desc: हिंदू धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक और भक्तजन ईश्वर का आशीर्वाद पाने के लिए भजन और भक्ति गीत गाते हैं तथा पवित्र श्लोकों का पाठ करते हैं।.

programme.title: तुलसी आरती
programme.sub-title: A singer sings a devotional hymn in worship of Goddess Tulsi, who is regarded as an incarnation of Goddess Lakshmi, invoking the spirit of devotion
programme.desc: एक गायक देवी लक्ष्मी का अवतार मानी जाने वाली, देवी तुलसी की पूजा में भक्ति भजन गाते हैं, और भक्ति की भावना का आह्वान करते हैं।.

programme.title: श्री नरसिंह मंत्र ध्यान
programme.sub-title: A recital of the Narasimha Mantra, one of the most powerful mantras believed to protect the devotees from all kinds of evils, is played
programme.desc: नरसिंह मंत्र का जाप किया जाता है, जो सबसे शक्तिशाली मंत्रों में से एक है और ऐसा माना जाता है कि यह भक्तों को सभी प्रकार की कष्टों से बचाता है।.

programme.title: संध्या आरती इस्कॉन जुहू
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees congregate at a sacred destination to participate in a holy ritual to seek blessings from the Almighty
programme.desc: धार्मिक पथ-प्रदर्शक और भक्त सर्वशक्तिमान से आशीर्वाद लेने के लिए पवित्र अनुष्ठान में भाग लेने के लिए पवित्र स्थान पर एकत्र होते हैं।.

programme.title: योग स्टोरीज़ (हिन्दी)
programme.sub-title: Sriman Gauranga Das, a religious leader, delivers an informative discourse on yoga and explains how it benefits the body and mind
programme.desc: धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक श्रीमन गौरांग दास, योग पर एक जानकारीपूर्ण प्रवचन देते हैं और बताते हैं कि यह शरीर और मन को कैसे लाभ पहुंचाता है।.

programme.title: श्री दामोदरस्तकम
programme.sub-title: A spiritual teacher explains the meaning of a hymn focused on Lord Krishna's life, explaining its significance and importance to the viewers
programme.desc: एक आध्यात्मिक पथ-प्रदर्शक भगवान कृष्ण के जीवन पर केंद्रित भजन का अर्थ और दर्शकों को उसका अर्थ और महत्व समझाते हैं।.

programme.title: धाम यात्रा

programme.title: योग स्टोरीज़ (इंग्लिश)

programme.desc: एक आध्यात्मिक पथप्रदर्शक एकता और विविधता पर व्यावहारिक प्रवचन देते हैं तथा भक्तों से अपनी सीमाओं को पहचानने और सहायता के लिए दूसरों से मदद लेने का आग्रह करते हैं।.

programme.title: नेक्टर वर्सेस

programme.title: நகைச்சுவை கலாட்டா
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
