programme.title: திரை தென்றல்
programme.sub-title: The host engages in a meaningful conversation with the viewers and plays Tamil movie songs on their requests
programme.desc: பார்வையாளர்களுடன் உரையாடலில் ஈடுபட்டு, அவர்களுடைய வேண்டுகோளின் பேரில் தமிழ் திரைப்படப் பாடல்களை வழங்கும் தொகுப்பாளர்.

programme.title: சுகமான ராகங்கள்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of popular melodious songs composed and performed by various renowned artists played back to back
programme.desc: பல்வேறு புகழ்பெற்ற கலைஞர்களால் இசையமைக்கப்பட்டு நிகழ்த்தப்பட்ட பிரபலமான மெல்லிசைப் பாடல்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு.

programme.title: பக்தி பாடல்கள்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of popular devotional songs in praise of deities performed by eminent artists is played back-to-back
programme.desc: புகழ்பெற்ற கலைஞர்களால் நடத்தப்படும் தெய்வங்களைப் போற்றும் பிரபலமான பக்திப் பாடல்கள் தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: ஆலய வழிபாடு
programme.sub-title: A religious scholar sheds light on the history behind various temples, as well as the significance and meaning of diverse rituals and customs
programme.desc: பல்வேறு கோயில்களுக்குப் பின்னால் உள்ள வரலாற்றையும், பல்வேறு சடங்குகள் மற்றும் பழக்கவழக்கங்களின் முக்கியத்துவம்.

programme.title: ஆன்மீக கதைகள்
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on various teachings and principles from the Hindu scriptures and encourages followers to reflect on the same
programme.desc: இந்து வேதங்களிலிருந்து பல போதனைகள் மற்றும் கொள்கைகளை விளக்கி பக்தர்களை அதைப் பற்றி சிந்திக்க ஊக்குவிக்கும் மதத் தலைவர்.

programme.title: நல்ல காலம் பிறக்குது
programme.sub-title: A renowned astrologer provides a comprehensive insight into the position of stars and makes astrological predictions for the 12 zodiac signs
programme.desc: ஒரு பிரபல ஜோதிடர் நட்சத்திரங்களின் நிலையை பற்றிய விரிவான நுண்ணறிவை அளிப்பதோடு, 12 ராசிகளுக்கும் கணிப்புகளை வழங்குகிறார்.

programme.title: நியூஸ்
programme.sub-title: The host provides the latest information, advancements, and developments regarding various political, economic and social issues
programme.desc: அரசியல், பொருளாதார மற்றும் சமூகப் பிரச்சினைகள் தொடர்பான சமீபத்திய தகவல்கள், முன்னேற்றங்கள் மற்றும் முன்னேற்றங்கள்.

programme.title: வணக்கம் தமிழா
programme.sub-title: The hosts interact with renowned personalities and also present the latest updates from across the globe, ranging from entertainment to technology
programme.desc: தொகுப்பாளர்கள் பிரபல ஆளுமைகளுடன் தொடர்பு கொண்டு, உலகம் முழுவதிலுமிருந்து சமீபத்திய புதுப்பிப்புகளையும் வழங்குகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: அனுமன்
programme.sub-title: When Hanuman, an ordinary boy, is blessed with extraordinary powers, he sets out on an adventurous journey and conquers various obstacles
programme.desc: ஒரு சாதாரண சிறுவனான அனுமன், அசாதாரண சக்திகளால் ஆசீர்வதிக்கப்பட்டபோது, ​​அவர் சாகசப் பயணத்தை மேற்கொண்டு தடைகளை வென்றார்.

programme.title: எதிர்நீச்சல்
programme.sub-title: Janani and the women of the household embark on a journey to pursue their ambitions in the wake of Aadhimuthu Gunasekaran's downfall, while navigating the challenges of society
programme.desc: சமூகத்தின் சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, தங்கள் லட்சியங்களைத் தொடர ஜனனியும் வீட்டுப் பெண்களும் ஒரு பயணத்தைத் தொடங்குகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: கயல்
programme.sub-title: Kayal, a selfless woman, earns to provide for her family after her father abandons them. Despite being overwhelmed with responsibilities, she puts her loved ones' well-being before her own happiness
programme.desc: தந்தைக்கு பின் குடும்ப பொறுப்புகளில் மூழ்கியுள்ள கயல், மகிழ்ச்சியை விட அன்புக்குரியவர்களின் நலனையே முன்னிறுத்துகிறாள்.

programme.title: கிச்சன் கலாட்டா
programme.sub-title: The host welcomes celebrity guests as they whip up their signature dishes alongside high-end chef creations, rustic village recipes and much more
programme.desc: விருந்தினர்கள் தங்களின் தனித்துவமான உணவுகளையும், சமையல் கலைஞர்களின் படைப்புகளையும், கிராமிய பாரம்பரிய சமையல் குறிப்புகளையும் மற்றும் பலவற்றையும் தயாரிக்கும்போது, ​​தொகுப்பாளர் அவர்களை வரவேற்கிறார்.

programme.title: பூங்கொடி
programme.sub-title: Poongodi's quest for self-establishment leads her to Saravanan, a man unwittingly controlled by his stepmother's manipulative ways
programme.desc: பூங்கொடியின் சுய தேடல் அவளை தன் மாற்றாந்தாயின் சூழ்ச்சிகளால் அறியாமலேயே கட்டுப்படும் சரவணனிடம் அழைத்துச் செல்கிறது.

programme.title: துளசி
programme.sub-title: A kind-hearted Tulasi strives hard to keep her family together and secure the happiness, well-being and future of her children at all costs
programme.desc: குடும்பத்தை ஒன்றாக வைத்துகொள்ளவும், குழந்தைகளின் மகிழ்ச்சி, நல்வாழ்வு மேலும் எதிர்காலத்தை பாதுகாக்கவும் பாடுபடும் துளசி.

programme.title: குறிஞ்சி
programme.sub-title: When circumstances compel an ambitious woman to wed a man with a tough personality, their initial friction slowly gives way to mutual understanding and eventually love
programme.desc: சூழ்நிலைகளின் நிர்ப்பந்தத்தால், லட்சியம் மிக்க ஒரு பெண், கடின குணமுடைய ஒரு ஆணை மணக்கிறாள். ஆரம்பகால முரண்பாடுகள் படிப்படியாக மறைந்து, பரஸ்பர புரிதலுக்கும் இறுதியில் காதலுக்கும் வழிவகுக்கிறது.

programme.title: அபிராமி
programme.sub-title: Abirami, a loving mother and devoted wife, places her family's happiness above all else. After enduring endless disrespect, she, with her daughter's support, sets out to rebuild her life
programme.desc: அன்பான தாயும் மனைவியுமான அபிராமி, தன் குடும்பத்தின் மகிழ்ச்சிக்கே முன்னுரிமை அளிக்கிறாள். எனினும், தொடர் அவமரியாதைகளை சந்தித்த பின், அவள் தன் மகளின் ஆதரவுடன் தன் வாழ்க்கையை மீண்டும் புதிதாகத் தொடங்குகிறாள்.

programme.title: சிறகுகள்
programme.sub-title: While weathering deep family turmoil, fate brings Dharmadurai and Parvathi together as they navigate greed and betrayal
programme.desc: கடினமான குடும்பச் சிக்கல்களைச் சமாளிக்கும் வேளையில், பேராசையையும் துரோகத்தையும் எதிர்கொள்ளும் தர்மதுரையையும் பார்வதியையும் விதி ஒன்று சேர்க்கிறது.

programme.title: இருமலர்கள்
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: தொலைக்காட்சியில் சிறந்ததைக் கொண்டுவருதல்.

programme.title: லக்ஷ்மி
programme.sub-title: Maha, her family's primary breadwinner, wants to keep supporting her family even after marrying Selvam. However, things become complicated as obstacles test their family bonds and marriage
programme.desc: மகா செல்வத்தை திருமணம் செய்தபிறகும், தாய் வீட்டை ஆதரிக்க நினைக்கும்போது, தடைகளால் அவர்களின் குடும்பத்தில் சிக்கலானது.

programme.title: மூவி டு பி அனௌன்ஸ்ட்
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in cinema
programme.desc: இந்நிகழ்ச்சி சினிமாவில் மிகவும் சிறந்தவைகளைக் கொண்டுவருகின்றது.

programme.title: நியூஸ்
programme.sub-title: The host provides the latest information, advancements, and developments regarding various political, economic and social issues
programme.desc: அரசியல், பொருளாதார மற்றும் சமூகப் பிரச்சினைகள் தொடர்பான சமீபத்திய தகவல்கள், முன்னேற்றங்கள் மற்றும் முன்னேற்றங்கள்.

programme.title: அன்னம்
programme.sub-title: Annam, a bright and cheerful young woman, faces the challenges of life while withstanding the harsh treatment from her stepmother
programme.desc: மகிழ்ச்சியான இளம் பெண் அன்னம், தனது மாற்றாந்தாயின் கொடுமைகளை சகித்துக்கொண்டு வாழ்க்கையின் சவால்களை எதிர்கொள்கிறார்.

programme.title: பைரவி
programme.sub-title: After losing her family in a tragedy, Bhairavi's life crumbles as she starts over at an unwelcoming home and job. But her goal to investigate the truth behind the accident pushes her forward
programme.desc: ஒரு துயர சம்பவத்தில் தனது குடும்பத்தை இழந்த பைரவி தனது வாழ்க்கையை மீண்டும் தொடங்க வேண்டிய கட்டாயத்திற்கு தள்ளப்படுகிறார். இருப்பினும், அந்த விபத்தின் பின்னணியில் உள்ள உண்மையை கண்டறிய வேண்டும் என்ற அவரது இலட்சியமே அவரைத் தொடர்ந்து முன்னேற தூண்டுகிறது.

programme.title: மருமகள்
programme.sub-title: Prabhu is a miser and puts his needs ahead of his family. Circumstances bring him closer to Aadhirai, who helps others selflessly
programme.desc: பிரபு, தன் குடும்பத்தை விட தன் தேவைகளுக்கு முன்னுரிமை அளிக்கிறான். ஆதிரையிடம் தன்னலமின்றி மற்றவர்களுக்கு உதவுகிறாள்.

programme.title: மூன்று முடிச்சு
programme.sub-title: Nandini, a vivacious girl, gets married to Suryakumar, a businessman. However, the couple strives to navigate their relationship along with balancing familial responsibilities
programme.desc: தொழிலதிபர் சூர்யகுமாரை மணக்கும் சுறுசுறுப்பான நந்தினி,இருவரும் குடும்ப பொறுப்புகளின் மூலம் உறவை வழிநடத்த முயலுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: శ్రీ లలితా సహస్రనామ స్తోత్రం
programme.sub-title: Professional singers perform a rendition of a devotional song, reciting the thousand names of Goddess Lalita, seeking her blessings
programme.desc: వృత్తిపరమైన గాయకులు లలితాదేవి వెయ్యి నామాలను పఠిస్తూ భక్తి గీతాన్ని ఆలపిస్తూ, ఆమె ఆశీర్వాదాలు కోరుకుంటారు.

programme.title: గణపతి స్తోత్రం
programme.sub-title: Several devotees gather to chant the Ganpati Stotram, a devotional chant, in praise of Lord Ganesha and seek his blessings
programme.desc: అనేకమంది భక్తులు కలిసి భక్తి శ్లోకమైన గణపతి స్తోత్రంతో వినాయకుడిని ఆరాధిస్తూ, స్వామి ఆశీర్వాదాలు కోరతారు.

programme.title: యాదాద్రి సుప్రభాతం
programme.sub-title: Hindu priests and devotees chant a comprehensive compilation of hymns in praise of Yadagiri Laxmi Narasimha Swamy to seek the blessings of the Almighty
programme.desc: పండితులు, భక్తులు యాదగిరి లక్ష్మీ నరసింహస్వామిని స్తుతిస్తూ ఆయన దీవెనలు పొందేందుకు కీర్తనల సంకలనాన్ని పఠిస్తారు.

programme.title: కాకడ హారతి
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees gather together to sing devotional hymns and perform sacred rituals in honour of Shirdi Sai Baba
programme.desc: షిర్డీ సాయిబాబా గౌరవార్థం ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువులు, భక్తులు ఒకచోట చేరి శ్లోకాలు పఠిస్తూ, పవిత్రమైన ఆచారాలను నిర్వహిస్తారు.

programme.title: శ్రీ వెంకటేశ్వర సుప్రభాతం
programme.sub-title: In veneration of Lord Venkateswara, devotees and priests listen to devotional songs and perform religious customs in order to seek his blessings
programme.desc: పండితులు, భక్తులు శ్రీ వెంకటేశ్వర స్వామివారి కృపాకటాక్షాలు కోరుతూ మతపరమైన ఆచారాలను నిర్వహించి, భక్తి గీతాలు ఆలపిస్తారు.

programme.title: శ్రీ విష్ణు సహస్రనామ స్తోత్రం
programme.sub-title: Devotees recite the Sri Vishnu Sahasranama Stotram, in the name of Lord Vishnu to seek blessings and lead a better prosperous life
programme.desc: భక్తులు మెరుగైన, సంపన్న జీవితాన్ని ప్రసాదించమని కోరుతూ, విష్ణువు నామాలతో కూడిన విష్ణు సహస్రనామ స్తోత్రాన్ని పఠిస్తారు.

programme.title: శ్రీరామ సుప్రభాతం
programme.sub-title: An all-encompassing collection of sacred and soulful hymns that are composed and performed at dawn to celebrate and praise Lord Rama
programme.desc: శ్రీరాముడిని స్తుతించడానికి, జరుపుకోవడానికి తెల్లవారుజామున కూర్చి పాడే పవిత్రమైన, మనోహరమైన శ్లోకాల యొక్క సమగ్ర సేకరణ.

programme.title: ఆంజనేయ సహస్రనామం
programme.sub-title: A Sanskrit hymn listing the 1,000 names of Lord Hanuman is recited to appease the Hindu deity and seek his divine blessings
programme.desc: ఆంజనేయ స్వామి వేయినామలతో కూడిన సంస్కృత శ్లోకం హిందూ దేవతను ప్రసన్నం చేసుకోవడానికి, ఆశీర్వాదాలను పొందేందుకు పఠిస్తారు.

programme.title: హనుమాన్ అభిషేకం
programme.sub-title: Hindu religious leaders and devotees participate in sacred rituals while chanting holy hymns to seek blessings from Lord Hanuman
programme.desc: ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువులు మరియు భక్తులు హనుమంతుడి ఆశీర్వాదం పొందడానికి పవిత్ర స్తోత్రాలను పఠిస్తూ పవిత్ర ఆచారాలలో పాల్గొంటారు.

programme.title: యాదాద్రి అభిషేకం
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees chant sacred prayers and hymns while performing a ritual to seek blessings from the Almighty
programme.desc: ఆధ్యాత్మిక గురువులు, భక్తులు భగవంతుడి కృపాకటాక్షాలను కోరుతూ శ్లోకాలను పఠిస్తూ, ఆచార వ్యవహారాలతో ప్రత్యేక పూజలు చేస్తారు.

programme.desc: भक्तजन सर्वशक्तिमान ईश्वर से अपनी सच्ची प्रार्थना करने तथा दिव्य आशीर्वाद प्राप्त करने के लिए विभिन्न भक्ति गीत और भजन गाते हैं।.

programme.title: जॉय ऑफ कृष्णा कान्शसनस
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees sing devotional songs and offer their sincere prayers to Lord Krishna, seeking his divine blessings
programme.desc: धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक और भक्तजन भजन गाते हैं और भगवान कृष्ण से सच्चे मन से प्रार्थना करते हुए उनका दिव्य आशीर्वाद मांगते हैं।.

programme.title: डिवोशनल मेलोज़
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of devotional hymns and songs are played back to back, praising the Almighty and seeking divine blessings
programme.desc: भक्ति भजनों और गीतों का एक व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है, जिसमें ईश्वर की स्तुति की जाती है और दिव्य आशीर्वाद की कामना की जाती है।.

programme.title: जॉय ऑफ कृष्णा कान्शसनस
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees sing devotional songs and offer their sincere prayers to Lord Krishna, seeking his divine blessings
programme.desc: धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक और भक्तजन भजन गाते हैं और भगवान कृष्ण से सच्चे मन से प्रार्थना करते हुए उनका दिव्य आशीर्वाद मांगते हैं।.

programme.title: பகாசுரன்

programme.desc: கலைஞர்கள் பங்கேற்கும் நகைச்சுவைக் காட்சிகளின் தொகுப்பு பார்வையாளர்களின் பொழுதுபோக்கிற்காக தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்படுகிறது.

programme.title: நியூஸ்
programme.sub-title: The host presents the latest news stories and developments pertaining to various political and socio-economic issues around the country
programme.desc: நாடு முழுவதும் உள்ள பல அரசியல் மற்றும் சமூக-பொருளாதார பிரச்சினைகள் தொடர்பான சமீபத்திய செய்திகள் மற்றும் முன்னேற்றங்கள்.

programme.title: கற்றது சமையல்
programme.sub-title: The host presents a wide range of delicious recipes, demonstrates their preparation and shares useful culinary tips with the viewers
programme.desc: எண்ணற்ற சுவையான சமையல் குறிப்புகளை வழங்குவதோடு, அவற்றை சமைத்து காண்பித்து மேலும், பயனுள்ள சமையல் குறிப்புகளை பகிர்கிறது.

programme.title: ராமானுஜர்
programme.sub-title: Ramanuja, a learned philosopher, travels the subcontinent and brings his teachings to ardent followers of the Hindu faith
programme.desc: கற்றறிந்த தத்துவஞானியான ராமானுஜம் நாடு முழுதும் சென்று இந்து மதத்தின் தீவிரப் பக்தர்களுக்கு தனது போதனைகளை கற்பிக்கிறார்.

programme.title: பிரியமானவள்
programme.sub-title: A gentle mother enjoys an idyllic existence alongside her spouse and offspring. However, a resentful companion secretly schemes to seize her fortune
programme.desc: பாசமுள்ள ஒரு தாய் தன் கணவர் மற்றும் பிள்ளைகளுடன் நிம்மதியான வாழ்க்கை வாழ்கிறாள். இருப்பினும், பொறாமை கொண்ட ஒரு நண்பர் அவளது செல்வத்தை அபகரிக்க இரகசியமாகத் திட்டமிடுகிறார்.

programme.title: கண்ணெதிரே தோன்றினாள்
programme.sub-title: Rathnam exchanges newborn babies Sakthi and Anitha to grant riches to his child. Therefore, Rudra faces destiny because Anitha grows improperly
programme.desc: ரத்னம் தன் குழந்தைக்கு சொத்து கிடைப்பதற்காக பிறந்த குழந்தைகளான சக்தி மற்றும் அனிதாவை மாற்றிவைக்கிறார், அதன் விளைவாக, அனிதா சரியாக வளராததால் ருத்ரா விதியை எதிர்கொள்கிறார்.

credits.actor: Malavika Avinash,Rekha Krishnappa,Papri Ghosh,Swetha Khelge,Vaishu Jayachandhiran,Jeevan G. Vaa,Kavitha Solairaja,Jayshri Jue,Ramachandran Mahalingam (Rathnam)

programme.title: தென்றல்
programme.sub-title: A young girl named Thulasi dreams of continuing her education despite living with a middle-class family that shuns her
programme.desc: தன் கனவுகளை அடைய உதவும் காதலன் தமிழுடனான, துளசியின் காதலை அவர்களின் குடும்பங்கள் ஏற்காததால் உறவு சோதனைக்குள்ளாகிறது .

credits.actor: Shruthi Raj,Deepak Dinkar,Hemalatha,Suzane George,Shanthi Williams,Subhalekha Sudhakar,Sadhana,Aishwariyaa Bhaskaran

programme.title: பீமா
programme.sub-title: Sekar admires Chinna and teams up with him to take over the streets of Chennai. However, things change drastically when Sekar falls in love and decides to change his ways
programme.desc: சின்னாவை மதிக்கும் சேகர், அவருடன் இணைகிறார். சேகர் காதலில் விழுந்தபின் விஷயங்கள் கடுமையாக மாறுகிறது.

credits.actor: Vikram (Shekhar),Trisha (Shalini),Prakash Raj (Chinna),Raghuvaran (Periyavar),Ashish Vidyarthi (Police Commissioner),Lakshmi Gopalaswamy (Padma),Thalaivasal Vijay (Saamy),Srinath (Guru),Sampath Raj (Periyavar's Son),Sanusha (Suchitra),Shridhar Kumar (Chinna's Friend),Bala Singh,Tanikella Bharani,Pawan,Kanal Kannan

programme.title: कथा सागर
programme.sub-title: An eminent spiritual leader elucidates on various stories from religious discourses, offering guidance and enlightenment
programme.desc: धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, श्रीमान लाल गोविंद दास आध्यात्मिक प्रवचन देते है, जहाँ वह भक्तों को एक पूर्ण जीवन जीने हेतु प्रेरित करने के लिए शिक्षात्मक तरीके से कथा पढ़ते है।.

programme.sub-title: The wildlife of the Maasai Mara reveals the raw beauty and realities of one of the most untamed lands, highlighting the daily struggle for survival and the balance between predator and prey

programme.title: கேங்க்ஸ் ஆஃப் பாபூன் ஃபால்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: As lockdown begins to ease, people start to return to Victoria Falls, and the Zambia gang has plenty of opportunity to perfect their ambushing techniques
programme.desc: சக்மா பாபூன்களின் நான்குகுழுக்கள் ஜிம்பாப்வே மேலும் ஜாம்பியாவின் எல்லையில் உணவு-பிராந்திய சக்திகளுக்கு போட்டியிடுகின்றன.

programme.title: அ சீட்டா'ஸ் ப்ரைட்
programme.sub-title: Chilli and her five cubs encounter young mother Inara and her four cubs. See what happens when their stand-off resolves into an unusual blended family
programme.desc: Witness a wildlife first: two cheetah mothers unite to raise nine cubs in South Africa's Karoo, overcoming danger, loss, and the odds to survive.

programme.title: தி க்ரேட் ரைனோ ராபரி
programme.sub-title: Not long after a mysterious robbery took a stuffed rhino head from an auction house in 2011, baffled police realised they faced a bizarre crime wave when almost 100 rhino horns were stolen over a year
programme.desc: In 2011, thieves started stealing rhino horns from museums and auction houses in a bizarrely British crime wave that swept the country, and the police were at a loss as to who was responsible.

programme.desc: குளிர் காலங்களில் இரையை பிடித்து அதன் குட்டிகளுக்கு உணவளிக்கும் பூனை, உயிர்வாழ போராடுவதை பற்றி வழங்கும் இயக்குனர்.

programme.title: ஃபோர்ஸ் ஆஃப் நேச்சர்
programme.sub-title: Reveals the incredible ways in which all life is impacted by our journey around the Sun. Earth's weather is becoming more extreme, and questions are being raised about animals' ability to adapt quickly and survive
programme.desc: Reveals the incredible ways in which all life is impacted by our journey around the Sun. We examine how massive seasonal events affect the lives of individual animals as their stories develop across the year.

programme.sub-title: The Glade is a paradise in the desiccated plains of Ruaha, where water is available year round. This bounty spawns strange relationships. But peace in the Glade is shattered when thousands of buffalo arrive to drink, followed by the Baobab pride
programme.desc: உணவுக்காக வேட்டையாடவும், தங்கள் நிலப்பரப்பைப் பாதுகாக்கவும் ஒன்றாக வரும் கம்பீரமான ஆப்பிரிக்க சிங்கங்களின் கதை.

programme.title: சன்ஸ் ஆஃப் என்காய்
programme.sub-title: An intimate look at the relationship between man and nature in one of the most iconic wild places on Earth: the Masai Mara, Kenya. A Maasai warrior guides viewers through natural epic events and spectacular wildlife
programme.desc: உலகின் பிரபல காடுகளில் ஒன்றான மசாய் மாரா, கென்யாவில் மனிதனுக்கும் இயற்கைக்கும் இடையிலான உறவை பற்றி அறிக.

programme.title: ஒன் டே இன் வைல்ட் ஜாம்பியா
programme.sub-title: Exploring the world of the Luangwa River during the dry season. Focusing on the daily routines of the local wildlife. From elephants gathering to quench their thirst to terrifying African wild dogs hunting at dusk
programme.desc: வறண்ட காலங்களில் லுவாங்வா ஆற்றின் அருகே விலங்குகள் தாகத்தை தணித்து சுற்றுச்சூழல் அமைப்பை பகிர்ந்து வேட்டையாடுவதை அறிக.

programme.title: லயனஸ் இன் எக்ஸைல்
programme.sub-title: Manyari takes an unusual step when she takes her young cubs away from the sanctuary of the clan
programme.desc: வனவிலங்கு சுற்றுச்சூழல் அமைப்பின் சவால்களை சமாளிக்கவும் தன் குட்டிகளை பாதுகாக்கவும் போராடும் பெண் சிங்கத்தின் பயணம்.

programme.title: அ வுல்ஃப்'ஸ் சாய்ஸ் - ஃபேமிலி ஆர் ஃப்ரீடம்?
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker provides detailed insights on the behaviours of wolves and how they become a pack or seek their own path as a lone wolf
programme.desc: ஓநாய்களின் நடத்தை, அவை எப்படித் தனக்கான வழியைக் கண்டுபிடிக்கின்றன, கூட்டாகவோ அல்லது தனி ஓநாயாகவோ என்பதை பாருங்கள்.

programme.title: ஆஃப்ரிக்கா'ஸ் சூப்பர் ஸ்னேக்
programme.sub-title: She has no hands, no arms, no legs, but she'll crush you to death in 15 minutes. She's an African rock python, and she's queen of the constrictors
programme.desc: ஆப்பிரிக்க ராக் மலைப்பாம்பின் மனிதனை உண்ணும் போக்குகள் மற்றும் ஒடுக்கும் திறனால் கொடிய விலங்குகளில் ஒன்றாக மாறுகிறது.

programme.title: தி லோன்லினஸ் ஆஃப் தி லெப்பர்ட்
programme.sub-title: Exploring the lives of solitary leopards, their habitat, behaviour, and challenges in the wild
programme.desc: தொகுப்பாளர் சிறுத்தைகளின் கதையை பகிர்ந்து, அதன் வாழ்விடம், நடத்தை மற்றும் காடுகளில் உள்ள சவால்களை ஆராய்கிறார்.

programme.title: வைல்ட் பை நேச்சர்
programme.sub-title: WILD BY NATURE is a television series about wild nature, which deals with the endemic fauna of Mexico, narrated from a fresh, intrepid, and original point of view with a message of conservation and care for our species. Our protagonist, the actor and naturalist Arturo Islas travels through the going into their jungles, deserts, and seas in search of the wonderful species of fauna: mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, fish, and insects. WILD BY NATURE is a great experience of adventure and knowledge of natural wealth
programme.desc: பல வாழ்விடங்கள் மற்றும் விலங்குகளை ஆராய்ந்து, அவற்றைப் பற்றிய சுவாரஸ்யமான உண்மைகளை பகிரும் இயற்கை ஆர்வலரான ஆர்துரோ.

programme.title: வைல்ட் பை நேச்சர்

programme.title: வைல்ட் ஃபைட்டர்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: The most elemental and pure survival is based on eating. If you are not healthy, strong and agile, you cannot compete to mate, you cannot defend your family from any threat, nor will you be able to achieve good status in your clan
programme.desc: உலகின் பல்வேறு பகுதிகளில் உயிர்வாழ்வதற்காக வன விலங்குகள் பின்பற்றும் பல்வேறு உத்திகள் மற்றும் வழிமுறைகளை பற்றி அறிக.

programme.title: சிஸ்டர்ஸ் யுனைடெட் த பிரைட் ஆஃப் நகுஹுமா
programme.desc: Five lionesses from the Nkuhuma Pride dominate the Djuma game reserve in the Kruger National Park, and cooperate with four stately male lions called the Birmingham Boys.

programme.title: ஆஃப்ரிக்காஸ் சீக்ரட் க்ரியேச்சர்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Diverse animal species display unique resilience and behaviour, facing numerous challenges as they adapt and struggle to survive in the wild
programme.desc: க்ரூகர் தேசிய பூங்காவில் வாழ பல சவால்களை சந்திக்கும் ஏழு திகைப்பூட்டும் விலங்குகளின் செயல்பாடுகளை இயக்குனர் ஆராய்கிறார்.

programme.title: வைல்டெஸ்ட் சர்வைவல்
programme.sub-title: Discover how some of the world's most extraordinary animals are also the smallest. This action-packed episode will take you deep into rainforests, under the oceans and across vast deserts
programme.desc: உணவை வேட்டையாட மற்றும் உயிர் வாழ மற்றும் காடுகளில் நிலைக்க பல்வேறு உயிர் தந்திரங்களை பயன்படுத்தும் காட்டு மிருகங்கள்.

programme.title: ப்ரைட் ரூல்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: Floodwaters recede and vast herds of prey return to the Chobe's banks. Keeza and her cub make a break for it while Caller and Tom Tom brawl with their enemies, and Einstein finally finds a mate
programme.desc: சிங்கங்களின் வாழ்க்கை, உயிர்வாழும் உள்ளுணர்வு மற்றும் பிற விலங்குகளிடமிருந்து பெருமையை பாதுகாக்கும் பழக்கத்தை அறிக.

programme.title: த ஜூ
programme.sub-title: Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals
programme.desc: பிராங்க்ஸ் மிருகக்காட்சிசாலையில் விலங்குகளின் பராமரிப்பு, அழியும் உயிரினங்களை காப்பதில் ஊழியரின் அர்ப்பணிப்பை அறிக.

credits.actor: Jim Breheny,John Sykes,Annie Rivas,Kathleen LaMattina,Pat Thomas,Colleen McCann

programme.title: க்ரிகீ! இட்'ஸ் த இர்வினிஸ்
programme.sub-title: Carrying on late wildlife conservationist Steve Irwin's mission to bring people closer to animals is now the mission of his family. Terri, Bindi and Robert Irwin return to Animal Planet, giving viewers access to their wildlife adventures around the world and the amazing animals that continue to inspire their conservation efforts. The series features the family caring for more than 1,200 animals at the Australia Zoo; overseeing a world-class wildlife hospital, the largest of its kind in the world; and conducting high-level global expeditions
programme.desc: விலங்குகளை கவனித்துக்கொள்ள ஆஸ்திரேலிய பூங்காவில் வேலை செய்யும் இர்வின் குடும்பத்தினர் பல போராட்டங்களை எதிர்கொள்கின்றனர்.

programme.title: ஜுவல்ஸ் ஆஃப் த நேச்சுரல் வர்ல்ட்
programme.sub-title: Explores stunning natural landscapes and how animals act on their protective and fierce nature to survive and reproduce

programme.title: க்ரிகீ! இட்'ஸ் த இர்வினிஸ்
programme.sub-title: Carrying on late wildlife conservationist Steve Irwin's mission to bring people closer to animals is now the mission of his family. Terri, Bindi and Robert Irwin return to Animal Planet, giving viewers access to their wildlife adventures around the world and the amazing animals that continue to inspire their conservation efforts. The series features the family caring for more than 1,200 animals at the Australia Zoo; overseeing a world-class wildlife hospital, the largest of its kind in the world; and conducting high-level global expeditions

programme.title: எர்த்'ஸ் ட்ராபிக்கல் ஐலாண்ட்ஸ்
programme.sub-title: From the makers of Earth's Greatest Rivers, Earth's Tropical Islands journeys to three of the most exotic, mysterious and remote islands on planet Earth: Madagascar, Borneo and Hawaii. In three episodes, the series reveals how these isolated and iconic tropical islands harbour remarkable wildlife and human castaways found nowhere else on Earth. Madagascar is the oldest island in the world, Borneo cradles more diversity of life than any other island, and Hawaii is the remotest island chain in the world. In a rapidly changing world, these fragile islands are a vital gauge for the health of our planet
programme.desc: அயல்நாட்டு, மர்ம மற்றும் தொலைதூர தீவுகலான மடகாஸ்கர், போர்னியோ மற்றும் ஹவாயில் மக்கள் மற்றும் விலங்குகளின் வரலாற்றை அறிக.

programme.sub-title: WILD BY NATURE is a television series about wild nature, which deals with the endemic fauna of Mexico, narrated from a fresh, intrepid, and original point of view with a message of conservation and care for our species. programme.sub-title: Carrying on late wildlife conservationist Steve Irwin's mission to bring people closer to animals is now the mission of his family. programme.title: శివ
programme.sub-title: Shiva is a brave and intelligent child who stays with his grandparents in Vedas City. He sets out with his gang of friends to save the citizens from all sorts of evil
programme.desc: వేదాస్ నగరంలో తన బామ్మాతాతాలతో నివసించే ధైర్యంగల శివ, మిత్రులతో కలిసి తన నగరాన్ని దుష్ట శక్తుల నుండి కాపాడాలనుకుంటాడు.

credits.actor: Nilufer Middey,Sonal Kaushal,Rupa Bhimani,Anamay Verma,Aditya Jaiswal,Brij Bhushan Sawhney,Manoj Pandey

programme.title: పాక్ పకావు
programme.sub-title: Follow the whimsical and absurd conversations of two friends and learn new things as they navigate life's everyday mysteries
programme.desc: ఇద్దరు స్నేహితుల విచిత్రమైన, మరియు అసంబద్ధమైన సంభాషణలను అనుసరించండి మరియు వారు జీవితంలోని కొత్త విషయాలను నేర్చుకోండి.

programme.title: పక్డమ్ పక్డై
programme.sub-title: There is a constant war between Doggy Don and the three clever mice who live in his house. However, with the help of Doggy Don's brother, an ex-army dog, they fight the mice to win back their house
programme.desc: తన ఇంట్లో మూడు ఎలుకలతో నిరంతరం యుద్ధం చేసే డాగీ డాన్, మాజీ ఆర్మీ కుక్కతో కలిసి తమ ఇంటిని సొంతం చేసుకోడానికి పోరాడతాడు.

programme.title: పినాకి అండ్ హ్యాపీ -ది భూత్ బంధుస్
programme.sub-title: Pinaki and his family of ghosts embark on spooky adventures and a series of fun and slapstick comedy as they try to fit in the outside world
programme.desc: పినాకి, అతని దెయ్యాల కుటుంబం బయటి ప్రపంచంలో ఇమిడిపోవడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తూ, భయానక సాహసాలు, హాస్య సంఘటనల పరంపరలో పయనిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Sonal Kaushal,Rajesh Kava,Manoj Pandey,Aranya Kaur,Pawan Kalra,Meghna Erande,Bhakti Jhaveri,Pooja Punjabi

programme.title: జిగ్ అండ్ షార్కో
programme.sub-title: Zig the hyena lives all alone on a desert island and schemes to eat Marina
programme.desc: జిగ్ అనే హైనా, మెరీనా అనే మత్స్యకన్యను తినడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తుంది, కానీ ఆమె మిత్రుడు షార్కో ఆమెని జిగ్ నుండి కాపాడతాడు.

credits.director: Olivier Jean-Marie,Andrés Fernández,Cédric Dietsch,Khalil Ben Naamane,Yani Ouabdesselam,Nicolas Bougard,Pierre-Gilles Stehr

programme.title: పినాకి అండ్ హ్యాపీ
programme.sub-title: The ghost family faces a direct head-to-head collision with humans as the supernatural world is turned upside down. Pinaki and Happy must navigate a wave of chaotic spirit pranks to restore balance and keep their household secrets perfectly safe
programme.desc: Happy and Pinaki live with their ghost family in Vibhooti Mansion. They embark on spooky adventures, uncover scary secrets, and discover courage, friendship, and bravery together.

programme.title: పాక్ పకావు
programme.sub-title: Follow the whimsical and absurd conversations of two friends and learn new things as they navigate life's everyday mysteries
programme.desc: ఇద్దరు స్నేహితుల విచిత్రమైన, మరియు అసంబద్ధమైన సంభాషణలను అనుసరించండి మరియు వారు జీవితంలోని కొత్త విషయాలను నేర్చుకోండి.

programme.title: పక్డమ్ పక్డై
programme.sub-title: There is a constant war between Doggy Don and the three clever mice who live in his house. However, with the help of Doggy Don's brother, an ex-army dog, they fight the mice to win back their house
programme.desc: తన ఇంట్లో మూడు ఎలుకలతో నిరంతరం యుద్ధం చేసే డాగీ డాన్, మాజీ ఆర్మీ కుక్కతో కలిసి తమ ఇంటిని సొంతం చేసుకోడానికి పోరాడతాడు.

programme.title: పినాకి అండ్ హ్యాపీ -ది భూత్ బంధుస్
programme.sub-title: Pinaki and his family of ghosts embark on spooky adventures and a series of fun and slapstick comedy as they try to fit in the outside world
programme.desc: పినాకి, అతని దెయ్యాల కుటుంబం బయటి ప్రపంచంలో ఇమిడిపోవడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తూ, భయానక సాహసాలు, హాస్య సంఘటనల పరంపరలో పయనిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Sonal Kaushal,Rajesh Kava,Manoj Pandey,Aranya Kaur,Pawan Kalra,Meghna Erande,Bhakti Jhaveri,Pooja Punjabi

programme.sub-title: The ghost family faces a direct head-to-head collision with humans as the supernatural world is turned upside down. Pinaki and Happy must navigate a wave of chaotic spirit pranks to restore balance and keep their household secrets perfectly safe

programme.sub-title: Follow the whimsical and absurd conversations of two friends and learn new things as they navigate life's everyday mysteries
programme.desc: ఇద్దరు స్నేహితుల విచిత్రమైన, మరియు అసంబద్ధమైన సంభాషణలను అనుసరించండి మరియు వారు జీవితంలోని కొత్త విషయాలను నేర్చుకోండి.

programme.title: పక్డమ్ పక్డై
programme.sub-title: There is a constant war between Doggy Don and the three clever mice who live in his house. However, with the help of Doggy Don's brother, an ex-army dog, they fight the mice to win back their house
programme.desc: తన ఇంట్లో మూడు ఎలుకలతో నిరంతరం యుద్ధం చేసే డాగీ డాన్, మాజీ ఆర్మీ కుక్కతో కలిసి తమ ఇంటిని సొంతం చేసుకోడానికి పోరాడతాడు.

programme.title: పినాకి అండ్ హ్యాపీ -ది భూత్ బంధుస్
programme.sub-title: Pinaki and his family of ghosts embark on spooky adventures and a series of fun and slapstick comedy as they try to fit in the outside world
programme.desc: పినాకి, అతని దెయ్యాల కుటుంబం బయటి ప్రపంచంలో ఇమిడిపోవడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తూ, భయానక సాహసాలు, హాస్య సంఘటనల పరంపరలో పయనిస్తారు.

credits.actor: Sonal Kaushal,Rajesh Kava,Manoj Pandey,Aranya Kaur,Pawan Kalra,Meghna Erande,Bhakti Jhaveri,Pooja Punjabi

programme.title: मोहिनि
programme.sub-title: Vaishnavi and Sandeep, a couple in love, are engaged to be married. However, things spiral out of control when she gets possessed by a lookalike who is thirsty for vengeance
programme.desc: वैष्णवी, संदीप से प्यार करती है और दोनों की सगाई हो जाती है। अचानक सब कुछ बदल जाता है, जब वैष्णवी अपनी हमशक्ल मोहिनी की आत्मा से प्रेतवाधित हो जाती है, जो संदीप के परिवार से बदला लेना चाहती है।.

credits.actor: Trisha (Mohini/Vaishnavi),Jackky Bhagnani (Sandeep),Mukesh Tiwari (Vicky),Suresh (Monk),Yogi Babu (Cotton),Poornima Bhagyaraj (Menaka),Rama (Mohini's mother),Sriranjani (Vaishnavi's mother),Ganeshkar (Ganesh),Jangiri Madhumitha (Madhu),Swaminathan (Balki)

programme.title: सीज़र
programme.sub-title: A contract killer and Seizer repossess vehicles from loan defaulters for a finance firm. However, their work takes a deadly turn when they cross paths with a vengeful gangster
programme.desc: एक कॉन्ट्रैक्ट किलर और सीज़र, वित्तीय फर्म के लिए ऋण न चुकाने वालों से वाहन छीन लेते हैं। हालाँकि, एक प्रतिशोधी गैंगस्टर से मुलाक़ात होने पर कहानी अलग मोड ले लेती है।.

credits.actor: Chiranjeevi Sarja,V. Ravichandran,Parul Yadav,Prakash Raj,Ravi Prakash,Nagineedu,Sadhu Kokila,Avinash,Ramesh Bhat

programme.title: मेहरबान
programme.sub-title: Ravi promises his father on his deathbed that he will take care of Chaurangilal's family whenever the need arises. However, a cunning Chaurangilal concocts a plan to leave Ravi bankrupt and take over his wealth
programme.desc: रवि अपने मरणासन्न पिता से वादा करता है कि वह चुरंगीलाल और उसके परिवार की देखभाल करेगा। हालाँकि, चुरंगीलाल, रवि के पैसों को चुराने और उसे कंगाल करने की साजिश रचता है।.

credits.actor: Mithun Chakraborty,Ayesha Jhulka,Shanti Priya,Sadashiv Amrapurkar,Anupam Kher,Ajinkya Deo,Kader Khan,Sulabha Deshpande

programme.title: शिवुडु
programme.sub-title: A carefree young man's life is disrupted by rising local crime, prompting him to fight back when his family faces danger
programme.desc: एक लापरवाह युवक का जीवन उसके इलाके में बढ़ते अपराध के कारण अस्त-व्यस्त हो जाता है और जब उसके परिवार को खतरे का सामना करना पड़ता है, तब वह उनसे लड़ने का फैसला करता है।.

credits.actor: Aadhi Pinisetty (Shiva),Nikki Galrani (Vanilla),Akanksha Singh (Yashoda),Sharath Lohithashwa,V. Jayaprakash,Mukhtar Khan,Harish Uthaman

programme.title: असली फाइटर
programme.sub-title: To free their imprisoned boss, a group of terrorists plans to bomb a flyover in Hyderabad. Amid all the chaos, unfortunately, a man and a woman get entangled in their plan
programme.desc: अपने कैद बॉस को छुड़ाने के लिए आतंकवादियों का एक समूह हैदराबाद में एक फ्लाईओवर पर बम विस्फोट करने की योजना बनाता है। दुर्भाग्य से, इस पूरी अफरा-तफरी के बीच एक आदमी और महिला उनकी योजना में उलझते हैं।.

credits.actor: Sundeep Kishan,Nithya Menen,Ravi Kishan,Rahul Dev,Ali,Prudhvi Raj,Tanikella Bharani,Ajay

programme.title: आवेशम
programme.sub-title: After moving into a hostel in Bangalore for their engineering course, three teenagers get into a terrible brawl with their seniors. To exact revenge, they decide to befriend a gangster
programme.desc: तीन लड़के इंजीनियरिंग की पढ़ाई करने के लिए एक हॉस्टल में जाते हैं, जहाँ उनकी सीनियर्स से झड़प होती है। बदला लेने के लिए वे एक गैंगस्टर से दोस्ती कर लेते हैं।.

credits.actor: Fahadh Faasil (Ranjith Gangadharan alias \"Ranga\"),Sajin Gopu (Ambaan),Hipzster (Ajas \"Aju\" Bhasi),Mithun Jai Shankar (Bibin \"Bibi\" Prakash),Roshan Shanavas (Shanthakumaran \"Shanthan\"),Midhun Suresh (Kutty),Neeraja Rajendran,Thankam Mohan,Pooja Mohanraj (Beauty),Preeti Bhardwaj (Sweety),Pramod Veliyanad,Ashish Vidyarthi,Mansoor Ali Khan (Reddy)

programme.title: इंटरनेशनल खिलाड़ी: दी आइरन मैन
programme.sub-title: Amrita's parents get killed. Years later, she falls in love with Aditya only to learn that he was the one who was accused of her parents' murder
programme.desc: अमृता के माता-पिता मारे जाते हैं। सालों बाद, वह आदित्य से प्यार करने लगती है, लेकिन यभी उसे पता चलता है कि उसके माता-पिता की हत्या का आरोप उसी पर है।.

credits.actor: Mahesh Babu,Amrita Rao,Murali Sharma,Ashish Vidyarthi,Kota Srinivasa Rao,Ajay,Nassar

programme.title: विजय राघवन
programme.sub-title: An honest IAS officer devotes his life to the upliftment of the youth in his locality. However, a corrupt businessman's ploy to poison these young minds compels him to challenge the criminal
programme.desc: एक ईमानदार आईएएस अधिकारी अपने इलाके के युवाओं के उत्थान के लिए अपना जीवन समर्पित करता है। लेकिन एक भ्रष्ट व्यवसायी, युवाओं के मन में ज़हर घोलने की कोशिश करता है, जिससे दोनों में दुश्मनी पैदा होती है।.

credits.actor: Vijay Anthony,Aathmika,Ramachandra Raju,Prabhakar,Divya Prabha,Shankar Krishnamurthy,Poo Ramu,Sachin Khedekar,Super Subburayan

programme.title: बलून
programme.sub-title: Jeevanand rents an old house in Ooty with his wife and nephew hoping to find inspiration to write a script. However, strange events begin unfolding in the house which are linked to his past
programme.desc: जीवानंद एक स्क्रिप्ट लिखने के लिए प्रेरित होने की उम्मीद में अपनी पत्नी और भतीजे के साथ ऊटी के पुराने घर में रहने के लिए जाता है। हालाँकि, घर में जीवानंद के अतीत से जुड़ी अजीब घटनाएँ घटने लगती है।.

credits.actor: Jai,Anjali,Janani Iyer,Yogi Babu,Joy Mathew,Nagineedu,Ramachandran Durairaj,K.S.G. Venkatesh,Subbu Panchu Arunachalam,Karthik Yogi

programme.title: नायक
programme.sub-title: Siddharth and Charan, two lookalikes who are fighting their own battles against evildoers, cross paths and join forces to take down Rawat, a ruthless minister
programme.desc: पुलिस, एक सॉफ्टवेयर इंजीनियर चरण को हत्या के मामले में गिरफ्तार होने वाली होती है लेकिन तभी असली हत्यारा, उसका हमशक्ल पकड़ा जाता है। उसकी कहानी सुनने के बाद चरण उसकी मदद करने का फैसला करता है।.

credits.actor: Ram Charan Teja (Charan \"Cherry\"/Siddharth Naayak),Kajal Aggarwal (Madhu),Amala Paul (Nandini),Dev Gill (Badvel),Brahmanandam (Jilebi),Jaya Prakash Reddy (Babji's Paternal Uncle),Rahul Dev (Babji),Raghu Babu (Babji's Henchman),Pradeep Rawat (Rawat),MS Narayana (Drunkard CBI Officer),Ashish Vidyarthi (CBI Officer)

programme.title: सीताराम कल्याण
programme.sub-title: Arya is an altruistic individual who constantly sacrifices his happiness for his loved ones. Consequently, his romance with innocent Geetha faces severe hurdles
programme.desc: एक नेकदिल युवक, आर्या को एक छोटे शहर की लड़की गीता से प्यार हो जाता है, लेकिन वे उनके प्यार के बीच आने वाली मुश्किलों से अंजान हैं।.

credits.actor: Nikhil Gowda,Rachita Ram,R. Sarathkumar,P. Ravi Shankar,Madhoo,Sanjay Kapoor,Bhagyashree,Adhitya,Chikkanna,Simran Mishrikoti,Joy Badlani,Girija Lokesh

programme.title: इंद्राणी
programme.sub-title: While pursuing further studies in Kolkata, Indrani falls for Sudarshan, and the couple gets married. However, their relationship turns sour because of their conflicting thoughts
programme.desc: कोलकाता में आगे की पढ़ाई के दौरान, इंद्राणी को सुदर्शन से प्यार हो जाता है और दोनों शादी कर लेते हैं। हालाँकि, अलग-अलग विचारों की वजह से उनके रिश्ते में खटास आ जाती है।.

programme.title: बैंगलोर 560023
programme.sub-title: A group of teenagers try to beat their longtime arch-rival from another locality in a local cricket tournament. However, betrayal and violence follow in their quest to win the coveted trophy
programme.desc: किशोरों का समूह एक स्थानीय क्रिकेट टूर्नामेंट में दूसरे इलाके की टीम को हराने की कोशिश करता है। हालाँकि, प्रतिष्ठित ट्रॉफी जीतने की उनकी चाहत में विश्वासघात और हिंसा होती है।.

programme.title: நற்செய்தி மலர்கள்

programme.title: மங்கலத்வனி / நித்யபூஜலிவிகோ
programme.sub-title: An expert plays the shehnai at Tirumala temple, which is considered to be auspicious and a harbinger of good luck, in front of a group of devotees
programme.desc: திருமலை கோவிலில் ஷெனாயின் இசை இசைப்பது சுபகரமாக கருதப்படுவதினால் பக்தர்களின் ஒரு குழுவுக்கு முன் அதை இசைக்கும் நிபுணர்.

programme.title: சுப்ரபாதம் லைவ்
programme.sub-title: Devotees sing a melodious rendition of 'Sri Venkateswara Suprabhatam', a hymn recited every morning at the Tirumala hill shrine, as a wake-up call for Lord Venkateswara, live
programme.desc: திருமலையில் தினமும் காலையில் வெங்கடேஸ்வரரை எழுப்ப ஓதப்படும் 'ஸ்ரீ வெங்கடேஸ்வர சுப்ரபாதம்' பாடலை பக்தர்கள் பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: தோமால / கொலுவு லைவ்
programme.sub-title: Priests at the Tirumala temple perform a ceremony and adorn the deity with floral garlands; devotees showcase sacred figurines at their homes, live
programme.desc: திருமலை கோவிலில் மூல தெய்வத்தை மலர் மாலைகளால் அலங்கரிக்கப்படுகிறது; வீடுகளில் திருசிலைகளை காட்சிப்படுத்தும் பக்தர்கள்.

programme.title: அர்ச்சனா லைவ்
programme.sub-title: Priests perform rituals at the famous hill shrine of Lord Venkateswara at Tirumala, live; priests perform the 'Chakrasnanam' ritual at Lake Swami Pushkarini near Tirumala Temple, live
programme.desc: வெங்கடேஸ்வரா மலைக்கோயிலில் அர்ச்சகர்கள் சடங்குகள் செய்கிறார்கள், நேரலை; 'சக்ரஸ்நானம்' செய்யும் பூசாரிகள்,நேரலை.

programme.title: நித்யபுஜலிவிகோ கட் 2
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty while providing insights into various sacred rituals and ceremonies
programme.desc: பல்வேறு புனித பூஜைகள் மற்றும் சடங்குகள் பற்றி விளக்கும்போது, கடவுளை போதனைகளை பற்றி பேசும் ஒரு மத தலைவர்.

programme.title: ஹனுமன்சாலிசா/நாராயணஸ்தோத்திரம்
programme.sub-title: Religious scholars chant revered devotional hymns in praise of Lord Hanuman for his strength; Religious scholars chant sacred hymns in praise of Lord Vishnu to seek his divine blessings
programme.desc: மத அறிஞர்கள் ஹனுமானின் வலிமைக்காக அவரைப் புகழ்ந்து பக்தி பாடல்களைப் பாடுகிறார்கள்; மத அறிஞர்கள் விஷ்ணுவின் தெய்வீக ஆசீர்வாதங்களைப் பெறுவதற்காக அவரைப் புகழ்ந்து புனிதப் பாடல்களைப் பாடுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: லைவ் ருத்ராபிஷேகம்- கார்த்திகமாசம்,தியானாராமம் -திருப்பதி
programme.desc: Devotees from across the region come together, perform elaborate rituals and seek blessings from the Almighty, live.

programme.title: லைவ் ருத்ராபிஷேகம்- கார்த்திகமாசம்,தியானாராமம் -திருப்பதி
programme.desc: Devotees from across the region come together, perform elaborate rituals and seek blessings from the Almighty, live.

programme.title: ஸ்ரீவாரிசேவாலு - அஷ்டதல பதாபத்மாராதரன
programme.sub-title: Religious leaders and devotees gather to perform sacred rituals, offer prayers and chant verses from sacred scriptures in praise and worship of the Almighty
programme.desc: புனித சடங்குகள் மற்றும் பிரார்த்தனை செய்து, கடவுளை போற்றி புனித நூல்களிலிருந்து வசனங்களை பாடும் மத தலைவர்கள்- பக்தர்கள்.

programme.title: ஸ்ரீமத் ராமாயணம் கிஷ்கிந்தா காண்டா
programme.sub-title: A religious scholar delivers a discourse on the fourth book of the Valmiki Ramayana, 'Kishkindha Kanda'. The chapters focus on Lord Rama and Lakshmana searching for Sita
programme.desc: வால்மீகி ராமாயணத்தின் நான்காவது புத்தகமான 'கிஷ்கிந்தா காண்டம்' குறித்து ஒரு சமய அறிஞர் சொற்பொழிவாற்றுகிறார், அதன் அத்தியாயங்கள் ராமர் மற்றும் லட்சுமணன் சீதையைத் தேடுவதை மையமாகக் கொண்டது.

programme.title: சதமானம்பவதி
programme.sub-title: Viewers send heartfelt wishes to friends and family on special occasions, while religious leaders offer prayers for their well-being
programme.desc: சிறப்பு சந்தர்ப்பங்களில் நண்பர்கள்-குடும்பத்தினருக்கு வாழ்த்துக்களை அனுப்புகையில், நல்வாழ்வுக்காக வழிபடும் மத தலைவர்கள்.

programme.title: பகவத்கீதா பாலவிகாசம் ஸ்ரீ கரிகாபதி
programme.sub-title: A religious leader provides a detailed discourse on the various spiritual teachings of the Bhagavad Gita to devoted followers
programme.desc: பகவத் கீதையின் பல்வேறு ஆன்மீக போதனைகள் குறித்து தனது பக்தியுள்ள பக்தர்களுக்கு விரிவான சொற்பொழிவை வழங்கும் மதத் தலைவர்.

programme.title: பக்தி கீதா மாலிகா
programme.sub-title: Talented vocalists and musicians sing various devotional songs, offering their prayers and seeking blessings from the Almighty
programme.desc: திறமையான பாடகர்கள்-இசைக்கலைஞர்கள் பல பக்தி பாடல்களை பாடி, தங்கள் பிரார்த்தனைகளை செய்து, இறைவனிடம் ஆசிகளை பெறுகிறார்கள்.

programme.title: స్మాషింగ్ సింబా
programme.sub-title: Simmba, an honest and courageous police officer, teams up with his fearless colleagues in his mission to confront and defeat the evil forces of society
programme.desc: నిజాయితీగల, ధైర్యవంతుడైన పోలీసు అధికారి సింబా, తన సహచరులతో కలిసి సమాజంలోని దుష్ట శక్తులను ఎదుర్కొవాలనుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: స్మాషింగ్ సింబా
programme.sub-title: Upon learning of Michael Money's sinister plan to steal the town's funds, Simmba leaps into action to stop him from executing the robbery

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్
programme.sub-title: Bheem is an extremely brave, strong and intelligent young boy. He often manages to solve everyone's problems which endears him to the townspeople of Dholakpur
programme.desc: చాలా ధైర్యవంతుడు, బలమైన, తెలివైన బాలుడు భీమ్, ఢోలక్‌పూర్‌ పట్టణవాసుల సమస్యలన్నింటినీ పరిష్కరించగలుగుతాడు.

credits.actor: Vatsal Dubey (Chhota Bheem),Julie Tejwani (Raju),Rupa Bhimani (Chutki),Sabina Malik Mausam (Kalia),Rajesh Kava (Jaggu),Prince Patel (Takiya)

programme.sub-title: Little Krishna has fun getting caught up in all sorts of mischief with his friends in Vrindavan. But when the evil Kansa sends his minions to disrupt his life, he jumps into action

programme.title: లిటిల్ కృష్ణ
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna, a mischievous child, lives in the village of Vrindavan. He decides to save the villagers from an evil king, Kamsa, who sends ferocious demons upon them

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్
programme.sub-title: Bheem is an extremely brave, strong and intelligent young boy. He often manages to solve everyone's problems which endears him to the townspeople of Dholakpur
programme.desc: చాలా ధైర్యవంతుడు, బలమైన, తెలివైన బాలుడు భీమ్, ఢోలక్‌పూర్‌ పట్టణవాసుల సమస్యలన్నింటినీ పరిష్కరించగలుగుతాడు.

credits.actor: Vatsal Dubey (Chhota Bheem),Julie Tejwani (Raju),Rupa Bhimani (Chutki),Sabina Malik Mausam (Kalia),Rajesh Kava (Jaggu),Prince Patel (Takiya)

programme.title: లిటిల్ కృష్ణ మెడ్లీస్
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna has fun getting caught up in all sorts of mischief with his friends in Vrindavan. But when the evil Kansa sends his minions to disrupt his life, he jumps into action
programme.desc: బృందావనంలో తన స్నేహితులతో కలిసి అల్లరి చేస్తూ సరదాగా తిరిగే శ్రీకృష్ణుడు, కంసుడి రాక్షసులను అంతం చేయడానికి సిద్దమవుతాడు.

programme.title: లిటిల్ కృష్ణ
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna, a mischievous child, lives in the village of Vrindavan. He decides to save the villagers from an evil king, Kamsa, who sends ferocious demons upon them
programme.desc: కొంటెవాడైన చిన్ని కృష్ణుడు, ప్రజలపైకి భయంకర రాక్షసులను పంపిన దుష్ట కంసుడి నుండి బృందావన ప్రజలను కాపాడాలనుకుంటాడు.

credits.actor: Prachi Save Saathi,Meghna Erande,Neil D'Monte,Anand Tiwari,Vikrant Chaturvedi,Soniya Nair,Cara Pareira

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్ దమ్యాన్ కి దేహశత్
programme.sub-title: Chhota Bheem and his friends visit Sagarpur on King Indravarma's orders. The gang fights monsters in order to protect the Jal Chakra, but things change when Damyaan makes an appearance
programme.desc: రాజు ఇంద్రవర్మ ఆజ్ఞపై సాగర్‌పూర్‌కి వెళ్లిన ఛోటా భీమ్, అతని స్నేహితులు జలచక్రాన్ని రక్షించడానికి రాక్షసులతో పోరాడతారు.

programme.title: యుద్ధకాల్
programme.sub-title: Kaal kidnaps Little Singham's parents to steal their power and use it to execute his wicked schemes. Later, he learns that he must encounter three different challenges to save his parents
programme.desc: లిటిల్ సింగం, కాల్ చేతిలో కిడ్నాప్ అయిన తన తల్లితండ్రులను కాపాడుకోడానికి మూడు సవాళ్ళను ఎదుర్కోవాలని తెలుసుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: ఎల్ఎస్ రైజ్ ఆఫ్ కాల్ వంశ్
programme.sub-title: As evil forces set forth to wreak havoc on earth, Little Singham, joined by his loyal friends, band together to save the planet
programme.desc: లిటిల్ సింగం, అతడి నమ్మకమైన స్నేహితులతో కలిసి భూమిపై విధ్వంసం సృష్టించడానికి వచ్చిన దుష్ట శక్తులతో పోరాడతాడు.

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్: ది క్యూరియస్ కేస్ ఆఫ్ స్వాప్డ్ సోల్స్
programme.sub-title: To seize the kids' souls, Anira swaps Bheem and his friends' souls with one another. Limited in their powers while swapped, Bheem and his team must find the source of Anira's powers to undo the spell

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్ - ది జర్నీ టు జీవ్‌లోక్, పార్ట్ 1

programme.desc: జీవలోకానికి చెందిన ఒక మాయా శిశువును కనుగొన్న భీమ్, ప్రపంచ సామరస్యాన్ని నెలకొల్పడానికి శాంతిస్థల్‌కు ప్రయాణిస్తాడు.

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్ ది జర్నీ టు జీవలోక్ పార్ట్ 02

programme.title: లిటిల్ కృష్ణ మెడ్లీస్
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna has fun getting caught up in all sorts of mischief with his friends in Vrindavan. But when the evil Kansa sends his minions to disrupt his life, he jumps into action
programme.desc: బృందావనంలో తన స్నేహితులతో కలిసి అల్లరి చేస్తూ సరదాగా తిరిగే శ్రీకృష్ణుడు, కంసుడి రాక్షసులను అంతం చేయడానికి సిద్దమవుతాడు.

programme.title: లిటిల్ కృష్ణ
programme.sub-title: Little Krishna, a mischievous child, lives in the village of Vrindavan. He decides to save the villagers from an evil king, Kamsa, who sends ferocious demons upon them
programme.desc: కొంటెవాడైన చిన్ని కృష్ణుడు, ప్రజలపైకి భయంకర రాక్షసులను పంపిన దుష్ట కంసుడి నుండి బృందావన ప్రజలను కాపాడాలనుకుంటాడు.

credits.actor: Prachi Save Saathi,Meghna Erande,Neil D'Monte,Anand Tiwari,Vikrant Chaturvedi,Soniya Nair,Cara Pareira

programme.title: ఛోటా భీమ్ ఔర్ లిటిల్ సింగం దో కా దమ్ పార్ట్
programme.sub-title: Chhota Bheem and Little Singham join forces to defeat the rising evil with their tactics and bring back happiness to their lands
programme.desc: ఛోటా భీమ్, లిటిల్ సింగంలు పెరిగిపోతున్న చెడుని అంతం చేసి తమ నగరంలో ఆనందం తీసుకురావడానికి చేతులు కలుపుతారు.

programme.title: చోటా భీమ్ ఔర్ లిటిల్ సింగం దో కా దమ్ పార్ట్ 02
programme.sub-title: Chhota Bheem and Little Singham join forces to safeguard 'Pari Mani', a precious and pious gem, and battle against the evil forces
programme.desc: చోటా భీమ్, లిటిల్ సింగంలు అమూల్యమైన, విలువైన 'పరి మణి' కాపాడడానికి దుష్ట శక్తులకు వ్యతిరేకంగా పోరాడతారు.

programme.title: లిటిల్ సింగం: సముద్ర కాల్ సే సంగ్రామ్
programme.sub-title: Little Singham embarks on a perilous mission to thwart the devious plan of an adversary, overcoming numerous challenges to safeguard the marine ecosystem
programme.desc: లిటిల్ సింగం సముద్ర పర్యావరణ వ్యవస్థను రక్షించడానికి ప్రత్యర్థి మోసపూరిత ప్రణాళికను అడ్డుకోవాలనుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: లిటిల్ సింగం - కన్స్ ఔర్ కాల్ కా రాజ్
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television

programme.title: రిటర్న్ ఆఫ్ లిటిల్ సింఘం
programme.sub-title: Little Singham, a brave and young police officer, sets out on epic adventures and fights against various evil entities in order to protect his city
programme.desc: ధైర్యవంతుడైన యువ పోలీసు అధికారి లిటిల్ సింగం, తన నగరాన్ని కాపాడడానికి వివిధ సాహససాలు చేస్తాడు, దుష్ట శక్తులపై పోరాడతాడు.

programme.title: గ్రిజ్జీ అండ్ ద లెమ్మింగ్స్
programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house
programme.desc: గ్రిజ్జీ అనే ఎలుగుబంటి ఒక అటవీ రేంజర్ ఇంటిని తన సొంత నివాసంగా భావిస్తుంది, అయితే లెమ్మింగ్స్ రాకతో పరిస్థితి మారుతుంది.

credits.director: Victor Moulin,Cédric Lachenaud,Alexandre Wahl,Corentin Lecourt,Clément Girard,Idriss Benseghir,Célestine Jacquel-Plays

programme.desc: లిటిల్ సింగం, ప్రజలను లొంగదీసుకుని, వారిని తన కీలుబొమ్మలుగా మార్చిన దుష్ట రాక్షసుడిని ఓడించడానికి సిద్దమవుతాడు.

programme.title: లిటిల్ సింగం:బాహుబలి ఫ్రెండ్స్ వర్సెస్ హలాకు
programme.sub-title: When Halaaku, a dangerous and unstoppable creature, causes destruction and chaos, Little Singham and his friends use their grit and wisdom to fight him and maintain peace

programme.title: లిటిల్ సింగం వర్సెస్ అసుర్ ఎటాక్
programme.sub-title: Little Singham encounters demons such as Daraku and courageously fights against their destructive abilities, thereby emerging victorious

programme.sub-title: Grizzy, a bear, lives in the forest ranger's house every time he leaves and considers it as his own. However, things change when a tribe of lemmings moves into the same house

programme.title: Material Witness
programme.desc: The FBI suspects' fraudulent business practices are linked to the mysterious disappearance of Candor Diamond Corporation president, Irwin Margolies. Weeks after Margolies turns up, and begins cooperating with authorities, several Candor employees are now the victims of brutal murders. The deaths all point to the work of a hired hit man, with possible links to Margolies, but it will take the concentrated efforts of federal agents to untangle the web of clues to convict the killers.

credits.actor: Mark Joy (Donald Nash),Carl Burrows,Keith Michael Gregory,Michael McKennitt,Tim L. Smith

programme.title: Monsters and Mysteries
programme.desc: Whether the protagonist is a Batsquatch, Skunk Ape, Mothman or Chupacabra, tales of mysterious creatures and unexplainable phenomena have been passed down generations. \"Monsters and Mysteries in America\" takes a trip across the U.S. to reveal the most cryptic, frightening and brow-furrowing stories. Each hourlong episode focuses on a specific region and the lore of residents who claim to have encountered legendary monsters, ancient spirits or alien beings. With America's dense forests, desert grasslands, and hundreds of miles of uninhabitable wilderness, could it really house -- or hide -- so many mysterious creatures?

programme.desc: Whether the protagonist is a Batsquatch, Skunk Ape, Mothman or Chupacabra, tales of mysterious creatures and unexplainable phenomena have been passed down generations. \"Monsters and Mysteries in America\" takes a trip across the U.S. to reveal the most cryptic, frightening and brow-furrowing stories. Each hourlong episode focuses on a specific region and the lore of residents who claim to have encountered legendary monsters, ancient spirits or alien beings. With America's dense forests, desert grasslands, and hundreds of miles of uninhabitable wilderness, could it really house -- or hide -- so many mysterious creatures?

programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्यक्रमों की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: बब्लू डबलू
programme.sub-title: An evil logger decides to turn the forest into his personal lumberyard. However, things change after Bablu and Dablu, two bear brothers, decide to stop him
programme.desc: एक दुष्ट लकड़हारा जंगल को अपना निजी लकड़हारा बनाने का फ़ैसला करता है। लेकिन, दो भालू भाइयों, बबलू और डबलू, द्वारा उसे रोकने के फ़ैसले के बाद चीज़ें बदल जाती हैं।.

programme.title: हनी बनी
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्यक्रमों की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: जंगल बुक
programme.sub-title: Mowgli, a young boy, is raised in the jungle by wolves. He has two loyal friends, Bagheera, a panther, and Baloo, a bear, who safeguard him from Shere Khan, a Bengal tiger, who wants to devour Mowgli
programme.desc: एक छोटा लड़का मोगली, जंगल में भेड़ियों के बीच पला-बढ़ा है। उसके दो वफादार दोस्त हैं, बघीरा (एक तेंदुआ), और बल्लू (एक भालू), जो उसे शेर खान (एक बंगाल टाइगर) से बचाते हैं, जो मोगली को खाना चाहता है।.

programme.desc: भक्तगण 12 ज्योतिर्लिंगों के दर्शन हेतु तीर्थयात्रा में भाग लेने के लिए एकत्रित होते हैं, जिन्हें भगवान शिव का दिव्य स्वरूप माना जाता है।.

programme.title: धर्म कथा
programme.sub-title: A religious leader sheds light on the teachings of the Almighty and encourages followers to take the path of spirituality
programme.desc: एक धार्मिक पथप्रदर्शक, ईश्वर की शिक्षाओं पर प्रकाश डालते हैं और अनुयायियों को आध्यात्मिकता का मार्ग अपनाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करते हैं।.

programme.title: भक्ति प्रवाह
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of ancient hymns and spiritual verses chanted in order to praise the Almighty is played back to back
programme.desc: यह कार्यक्रम, परमेश्वर की स्तुति के लिए संगीतबद्ध किए गए प्राचीन भजनों और आध्यात्मिक छंदों का व्यापक संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।.

programme.title: भूत बॉस (पाप-ओ-मीटर)
programme.sub-title: Bhoot Boss, Thakela and Pakela are ghosts who seek out people that have sinned and teach them a lesson to reduce wrongdoings in the world. However, their mission lands them in precarious situations
programme.desc: भूत बॉस, थकेला और पकेला भूत हैं जो पाप करने वाले लोगों को ढूंढ उन्हें सबक सिखाते हैं। हालांकि, उनका मिशन उन्हें अनिश्चित परिस्थितियों में डाल देता है।.

programme.title: जानबाज़ मुर्गा
programme.sub-title: A fun-loving chicken along with his friends embark on various adventures, as they overcome challenges and share heartfelt moments
programme.desc: एक मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला मुर्गा अपने दोस्तों के साथ विभिन्न साहसिक कार्यों पर निकलता है, जहां वे चुनौतियों पर विजय प्राप्त करते हैं और दिल को छू लेने वाले पल साझा करते हैं।.

programme.title: हनी बनी
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: टेलीविजन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ कार्यक्रमों की प्रस्तुति।.

programme.title: जंगल बुक
programme.sub-title: Mowgli, a young boy, is raised in the jungle by wolves. He has two loyal friends, Bagheera, a panther, and Baloo, a bear, who safeguard him from Shere Khan, a Bengal tiger, who wants to devour Mowgli
programme.desc: एक छोटा लड़का मोगली, जंगल में भेड़ियों के बीच पला-बढ़ा है। उसके दो वफादार दोस्त हैं, बघीरा (एक तेंदुआ), और बल्लू (एक भालू), जो उसे शेर खान (एक बंगाल टाइगर) से बचाते हैं, जो मोगली को खाना चाहता है।.

programme.title: बब्लू डबलू
programme.sub-title: An evil logger decides to turn the forest into his personal lumberyard. However, things change after Bablu and Dablu, two bear brothers, decide to stop him
programme.desc: एक दुष्ट लकड़हारा जंगल को अपना निजी लकड़हारा बनाने का फ़ैसला करता है। लेकिन, दो भालू भाइयों, बबलू और डबलू, द्वारा उसे रोकने के फ़ैसले के बाद चीज़ें बदल जाती हैं।.

programme.title: जीजा जी छत पर है
programme.sub-title: Elaichi's mischievous antics keep her father Murari on edge, while Pancham, secretly in love with her, navigates hilarious mishaps due to his hidden marital status
programme.desc: इलायची की शरारतें उसके पिता मुरारी को परेशान रखती हैं, जबकि पंचम, जो मन ही मन इलायची से प्यार करता है, अपनी छुपी हुई वैवाहिक स्थिति के कारण हास्यास्पद घटनाओं से गुजरता है।.

programme.title: मद्दाम सर
programme.sub-title: Four brave female police officers of Aminabad police station use their wittiness and emotional intelligence to tackle the various challenges they face at their work
programme.desc: अमीनाबाद पुलिस स्टेशन की चार बहादुर महिला पुलिस अधिकारी अपने कार्यस्थल की विभिन्न चुनौतियों से निपटने के लिए अपनी बुद्धिमता और भावनात्मक बुद्धिमत्ता का उपयोग करती हैं।.

programme.title: ஆசை 100 வகை
programme.sub-title: A series of dramatised re-enactments of cases revolving around various horrifying and unscrupulous activities that conspire in society
programme.desc: சமூகத்தில் சதி செய்யும் பல்வேறு திகிலூட்டும் மற்றும் நேர்மையற்ற செயல்களைச் சுற்றியுள்ள வழக்குகளின் தொடர்ச்சியான நாடகமாக்கப்பட்ட மறு-நடவடிக்கைகள்.

programme.title: மிக்ஸ்டேப் பாடல்கள்
programme.sub-title: A comprehensive compilation of some of the most popular and beloved musical numbers from the year, played consecutively
programme.desc: வருடத்தில் மிகவும் பிரபலமான மற்றும் பிரியமான சில இசை எண்களின் விரிவான தொகுப்பு, தொடர்ச்சியாக இசைக்கப்பட்டது.

programme.title: Baal Krishna
programme.desc: Krishna, the young son of Devaki and Vasudeva, embarks on a series of adventures where he befriends the people of Vrindavan, his hometown, and saves them from difficulties.

credits.actor: Nimai Bali,Meet Mukhi,Sachin Shroff,Deshna Dugad,Ram Awana

programme.title: கணபதியே வருவாய்
programme.sub-title: After Lord Shiva beheads Ganesha, Goddess Parvati asks for his resurrection with an elephant's head. Despite facing many challenges after this, Ganesha transforms from an ostracized child into the most beloved deity
programme.desc: சிவன் கணேசனின் தலையை துண்டித்த பிறகு, பார்வதி தேவி யானை தலையுடன் மீண்டும் உயிர்ப்பிக்குமாறு கோரியபின், சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, கணேசன் ஒதுக்கப்பட்ட குழந்தையிலிருந்து மிகவும் விரும்பப்படும் தெய்வமாகிறார்.

programme.title: கால பைரவன்
programme.sub-title: Jogeshwari is the daughter of Dakshan who hates Shiva and worships Vishnu. When Dakshan forces Jogeshwari to marry, she rebels because of her dedication towards Bhairavan, a devout devotee of Shiva
programme.desc: சிவனை வெறுத்து விஷ்ணுவை வழிபடும் தட்சன், அவரது மகள் ஜோகேஸ்வரியை திருமணம் செய்ய வற்புறுத்தும்போது, அவளோ சிவனின் தீவிர பக்தரான பைரவன் மீதான தனது பக்தியின் காரணமாக எதிர்க்கிறாள்.

programme.title: அண்ணாமலை
programme.sub-title: Generations of rivalry come to light as two families fight for control of a revered temple while personal emotions complicate the path to peace
programme.desc: தனிப்பட்ட உணர்வுகள் அமைதிக்கான பாதையை சிக்கலாக்கும் அதே வேளையில், ஒரு புனிதமான கோவிலின் கட்டுப்பாட்டிற்காக இரண்டு குடும்பங்கள் சண்டையிடுவதால், தலைமுறையாக இருந்துவரும் அவர்களின் பகைமை வெளிச்சத்திற்கு வருகிறது.

credits.actor: Sivakumar,Radikaa Sarathkumar,Shyam Ganesh,Kuyili,Ponvannan,Viji Chandrasekhar,Shanmuga Sundaram,Jyothi Lakshmi

programme.title: தாமரை
programme.sub-title: Sneha and Dwarkesh fall in love, and they secretly register their marriage. However, their relationship is tested as they face various obstacles
programme.desc: காதலர்களான சினேகாவும் துவாரகேஷும் ரகசியமாக பதிவு திருமணம் செய்து கொள்கிறார்கள். ஆனால், அவர்கள் பல்வேறு தடைகளைச் சந்திக்கும் பொழுது அவர்களின் உறவு சோதிக்கப்படுகிறது.

credits.director: K.J Thangapandiyan,Hafees,A. Ramachandran,M.K. Arunthavaraja,S. Anand Babu

programme.title: Selvi
programme.desc: Selvi, a young girl, has academic ambition that she wants to pursue by moving to the city from her village. However, her family wants her to get married.

programme.title: அம்மன்
programme.sub-title: Sakthi is blessed by the Goddess Amman with the power to foresee the future. Her life takes an unexpected turn when she meets an atheist doctor
programme.desc: அம்மன் தேவியால் சக்தி எதிர்காலத்தை கணிக்கும் அருளை பெறுகிறாள். அவள் ஒரு நாத்திக மருத்துவரை சந்திக்கும்போது, அவளது வாழ்க்கை எதிர்பாராத திருப்பத்தை அடைகிறது.

credits.actor: Pavithra Gowda (Sakthi),Amaljith (Eshwar),Nivisha (Durga),Surjith Ansary (Kishore),Nanditha Jennifer (Saradha),Nisha Jagadeeswaran (Logambal),Shaliy Avinesh (Logambal),Shobana (Naga),Anita Nair (Lakshmi),Rathan Ganapathy (Mahendran),Avinash Ashok (Aravindh),Anu Sulash (Neha),Shubha Raksha (Inba)

programme.title: கணபதியே வருவாய்
programme.sub-title: After Lord Shiva beheads Ganesha, Goddess Parvati asks for his resurrection with an elephant's head. Despite facing many challenges after this, Ganesha transforms from an ostracized child into the most beloved deity
programme.desc: சிவன் கணேசனின் தலையை துண்டித்த பிறகு, பார்வதி தேவி யானை தலையுடன் மீண்டும் உயிர்ப்பிக்குமாறு கோரியபின், சவால்களை எதிர்கொண்டு, கணேசன் ஒதுக்கப்பட்ட குழந்தையிலிருந்து மிகவும் விரும்பப்படும் தெய்வமாகிறார்.

programme.title: கர்ணா
programme.sub-title: Karna, the son of the Sun God and Kunti, faces hardships from birth but strives to prove his worth. Overcoming challenges, he rises to become one of the most formidable archers and warriors in the Mahabharata
programme.desc: பிறப்பிலிருந்தே பல சவால்களை தாண்டி மகாபாரதத்தில் சிறந்த வில்லாளி மற்றும் போர்வீரராகும் சூரியன், குந்தியின் மகன் கர்ணன்.

programme.title: தெனாலி ராமன்
programme.sub-title: Tenali Raman, an advisor at the court of King Krishnadevaraya, uses his sharp presence of mind and wisdom to solve the difficult matters of the kingdom and its people daily
programme.desc: தனது கூர்மையான மனதையும் ஞானத்தையும் பயன்படுத்தி, ராஜ்ஜியம் மற்றும் மக்களின் கடினமான விஷயங்களை தீர்க்கும் தெனாலி ராமன்.

credits.actor: Krishna Bharadwaj,Pankaj Berry,Manav Gohil,Jitendra Pathak,Sohit Soni,Sanjay Mangnani,Priyamvada Kant,Nimisha Vakharia

programme.title: பாக்யஜாதகம்
programme.sub-title: Indulekha, a woman who gets a chance to reunite with Parvathy, her long-lost mother, after being abandoned by her own relatives at an early age
programme.desc: இந்துலேகா சிறு வயதிலேயே தன் சொந்த உறவினர்களால் கைவிடப்பட்ட பிறகு, நீண்ட நாட்களாகப் பிரிந்திருந்த தன் தாய் பார்வதியுடன் மீண்டும் இணையும் வாய்ப்பைப் பெறுகிறார்.

programme.title: அலாதின்

programme.title: మెడిటరేనియన్ హంటర్స్
programme.desc: Mediterranean Hunters.

programme.title: టైగర్ లెగసీ
programme.sub-title: The crew looks at the various challenges mothers of different species face to survive and keep their cubs alive
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు ఏడేళ్లుగా తడోబాలోని నాలుగు ఆడ పులులు, వాటి పిల్లల జీవితాలు, సహజ ఆవాసాలలో వాటి ప్రవర్తనలను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: లేక్ లైఫ్: సీక్రెట్స్ బినీత్ ది సర్ఫేస్
programme.desc: Dive beneath the surface to explore rare species, geological wonders and unique ecosystems in Germany's and Austria's most stunning lakes.

programme.title: Fight For Life
programme.desc: Discover the story of the rehabilitation of an African national park. After the first step of successfully acclimatising herbivores, it is time to reintroduce lions. But with them comes predation, and suddenly, fear overtakes the park.

programme.title: మెడిటరేనియన్ హంటర్స్
programme.desc: Mediterranean Hunters.

programme.title: ఎ రైనోస్ లైఫ్
programme.sub-title: A mother rhinoceros trains her two-year-old son to survive in the grasslands of Uganda, and both undergo a test of time when she gives birth to a new calf
programme.desc: ఉగాండాలో తన రెండేళ్ల కొడుకుకి మనుగడ నైపుణ్యాలు నేర్పుతున్న ఖడ్గమృగం మరొకరికి జన్మనిచ్చినప్పుడు సవాళ్లు ఎదుర్కొంటాయి.

programme.title: World's Wildest
programme.desc: World's Wildest.

programme.title: ఎయిర్ జాస్: ది హంట్ ఫర్ కొలోసస్
programme.sub-title: A 20-foot great white breaches in New Zealand, sparking a hunt for Colossus, the flying shark who went missing 10 years ago from South Africa's waters; could he still be alive and lead researchers to a secret colony of lost great whites?
programme.desc: న్యూజిలాండ్‌లో భారీ వైట్ షార్క్ నీటిపైకి రావడంతో, 'కొలోసస్' అనే పురాతన సొరచేపను వెతకడానికి ఒక అన్వేషణను ప్రేరేపిస్తుంది.

programme.title: లేక్ లైఫ్: సీక్రెట్స్ బినీత్ ది సర్ఫేస్
programme.desc: Dive beneath the surface to explore rare species, geological wonders and unique ecosystems in Germany's and Austria's most stunning lakes.

programme.title: Fight For Life
programme.desc: Discover the story of the rehabilitation of an African national park. After the first step of successfully acclimatising herbivores, it is time to reintroduce lions. But with them comes predation, and suddenly, fear overtakes the park.

programme.title: డై లియోపార్డిన్
programme.sub-title: The Serengeti and its labyrinth of gallery forests are the home of a leopardess. To her family she is both caring provider and fearless defender. For her prey she is sudden death, for her son the only chance to survive in this unforgiving wilderness
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు చిరుతపులిలను వాటి సహజ నివాస స్థలంలో బంధించాడు,పిల్లిజాతి ప్రెడేటర్ సామాజిక జీవితం, మనుగడ వ్యూహాలపై వివరిస్తారు.

programme.title: World's Wildest
programme.desc: World's Wildest.

programme.title: మై జాగ్వార్ లైఫ్
programme.sub-title: Bringing the best in television
programme.desc: అత్యుత్తమ టెలివిజన్ కార్యక్రమాలు.

programme.title: సిస్టర్స్ యునైటెడ్ ది ప్రైడ్ ఆఫ్ నుహుమా
programme.desc: Five lionesses from the Nkuhuma Pride dominate the Djuma game reserve in the Kruger National Park, and cooperate with four stately male lions called the Birmingham Boys.

programme.title: World's Wildest
programme.desc: World's Wildest.

programme.title: ది ఇన్‌క్రెడిబుల్ ఫైవ్: ఎ చీతాస్ టేల్
programme.sub-title: Cheetahs are the high-speed hunters of the Savannah but few attempt to take on larger prey than gazelles or smallish antelopes
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు సవన్నాలో హై-స్పీడ్ హంటర్స్ అని పిలవబడే చిరుతలకు సంబంధించిన ఆశ్చర్యకరంగా భిన్నమైన కోణాన్ని అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: మసాయి మారా: ఆఫ్రికన్ వైల్డ్ లైఫ్ స్టోరీస్
programme.sub-title: The wildlife of the Maasai Mara reveals the raw beauty and realities of one of the most untamed lands, highlighting the daily struggle for survival and the balance between predator and prey
programme.desc: మాసాయి మారా వన్యప్రాణులు, మనుగడ కోసం రోజువారీ పోరాటాన్ని మరియు ప్రెడేటర్ మరియు ఎర మధ్య సమతుల్యతను వివరిస్తారు.

programme.title: గ్యాంగ్స్ ఆఫ్ బబూన్ ఫాల్స్
programme.sub-title: As lockdown begins to ease, people start to return to Victoria Falls, and the Zambia gang has plenty of opportunity to perfect their ambushing techniques
programme.desc: జింబాబ్వే, జాంబియా సరిహద్దులో నాలుగు చక్మా బబూల్ బృందాలు ఆహారం, ప్రాతీయ అధికారాల కోసం ఒకదానితో మరొకటి పోటీపడతాయి.

programme.title: ఎ చీతాస్ ప్రైడ్

programme.title: ది గ్రేట్ రైనో రాబరీ
programme.sub-title: Not long after a mysterious robbery took a stuffed rhino head from an auction house in 2011, baffled police realised they faced a bizarre crime wave when almost 100 rhino horns were stolen over a year

programme.title: ది లయన్స్ రూల్
programme.sub-title: The Glade is a paradise in the desiccated plains of Ruaha, where water is available year round. This bounty spawns strange relationships. But peace in the Glade is shattered when thousands of buffalo arrive to drink, followed by the Baobab pride
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు ఆహారం కోసం వేటాడి, తమ ప్రాంతాన్ని కాపాడుకోవడం కోసం ఏకం అయ్యే గంభీరమైన ఆఫ్రికన్ సింహాల మనుగడ కథను చూపుతారు.

programme.title: సన్స్ ఆఫ్ ఎంకై
programme.sub-title: An intimate look at the relationship between man and nature in one of the most iconic wild places on Earth: the Masai Mara, Kenya. A Maasai warrior guides viewers through natural epic events and spectacular wildlife
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు గ్రహం మీద అత్యంత ప్రసిద్ధి చెందిన అరణ్య ప్రాంతాలలో ప్రకృతి, మానవజాతి మధ్య బంధాన్ని నిశితంగా పరిశీలిస్తారు.

programme.title: వన్ డే ఇన్ వైల్డ్ జాంబియా
programme.sub-title: Exploring the world of the Luangwa River during the dry season. Focusing on the daily routines of the local wildlife. From elephants gathering to quench their thirst to terrifying African wild dogs hunting at dusk
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు వేసవిలో లుయాంగ్వా నది వద్ద తమ దాహాన్ని తీర్చుకోడానికి, వేటాడేందుకు వచ్చే వివిధ జంతువుల దినచర్యను అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: లయనెస్ ఇన్ ఎక్సైల్
programme.sub-title: Manyari takes an unusual step when she takes her young cubs away from the sanctuary of the clan
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు, తన పిల్లలను రక్షిస్తూ, సవాళ్లను అధిగమించడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తున్న ఆడ సింహం ప్రయాణాన్ని అనుసరిస్తారు.

programme.title: ఎ వోల్ఫ్స్ ఛాయిస్ ఫ్యామిలీ ఆర్ ఫ్రీడమ్
programme.sub-title: The filmmaker provides detailed insights on the behaviours of wolves and how they become a pack or seek their own path as a lone wolf
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు, తోడేళ్ళ ప్రవర్తన గురించి, ఒక గుంపుగా లేదా ఒంటరి తోడేలుగా తమ సొంత మార్గాన్ని ఎలా వెతుక్కుంటాయో చూపుతారు.

programme.title: ఆఫ్రికాస్ సూపర్ స్నేక్
programme.sub-title: She has no hands, no arms, no legs, but she'll crush you to death in 15 minutes. She's an African rock python, and she's queen of the constrictors
programme.desc: ఆఫ్రికన్ రాక్ ని ఆక్రమించిన కొండచిలువలు మనిషిని తినే భీకరమైన లక్షణాలను కలిగి, ఆ ఖండంలోనే భయానక మాంసాహారులుగా పేరొందాయి.

programme.title: ది లోన్లినెస్ ఆఫ్ ది లెపర్డ్
programme.sub-title: Exploring the lives of solitary leopards, their habitat, behaviour, and challenges in the wild
programme.desc: వ్యాఖ్యాత ఒంటరి చిరుతపులుల ఆకర్షణీయమైన కథను పంచుకుంటూ, వాటి ఆవాసాలు, ప్రవర్తన, అడవిలో సవాళ్లను అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ బై నేచర్
programme.sub-title: WILD BY NATURE is a television series about wild nature, which deals with the endemic fauna of Mexico, narrated from a fresh, intrepid, and original point of view with a message of conservation and care for our species. Our protagonist, the actor and naturalist Arturo Islas travels through the going into their jungles, deserts, and seas in search of the wonderful species of fauna: mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, fish, and insects. WILD BY NATURE is a great experience of adventure and knowledge of natural wealth
programme.desc: నటుడు, ప్రకృతి శాస్త్రవేత్త ఆర్థర్ ఇస్లాస్ అనేక రకాల జంతువుల ఆవాసాలు, వాటికి సంబంధించిన ఆసక్తికర విషయాలను పంచుకుంటారు.

programme.title: వైల్డ్ బై నేచర్

programme.title: వైల్డ్ ఫైటర్స్
programme.sub-title: The most elemental and pure survival is based on eating. If you are not healthy, strong and agile, you cannot compete to mate, you cannot defend your family from any threat, nor will you be able to achieve good status in your clan
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు ప్రపంచంలోని వివిధ ప్రాంతాలలో మనుగడ కోసం అడవి జంతువులు అనుసరించే వ్యూహాలు, పద్దతుల గురించి చూపుతారు.

programme.title: సిస్టర్స్ యునైటెడ్ ది ప్రైడ్ ఆఫ్ నుహుమా
programme.desc: Five lionesses from the Nkuhuma Pride dominate the Djuma game reserve in the Kruger National Park, and cooperate with four stately male lions called the Birmingham Boys.

programme.title: ఆఫ్రికాస్ సీక్రెట్ క్రియేచర్స్
programme.sub-title: Diverse animal species display unique resilience and behaviour, facing numerous challenges as they adapt and struggle to survive in the wild
programme.desc: వ్యాఖ్యాత ఆఫ్రికాలోని జంతువుల ప్రవర్తన, మనుగడ వ్యూహాలను అన్వేషిస్తూ, వాటికి చెందిన ఆసక్తికర విషయాలను పంచుకుంటారు.

programme.title: వైల్డెస్ట్ సర్వైవల్
programme.sub-title: Discover how some of the world's most extraordinary animals are also the smallest. This action-packed episode will take you deep into rainforests, under the oceans and across vast deserts
programme.desc: ఆహారాన్ని వేటాడేందుకు మరియు అడవిలో జీవించి జీవించడానికి వివిధ మనుగడ వ్యూహాలను ఉపయోగించే అడవి జంతువులు.

programme.title: ప్రైడ్ రూల్స్
programme.sub-title: Floodwaters recede and vast herds of prey return to the Chobe's banks. Keeza and her cub make a break for it while Caller and Tom Tom brawl with their enemies, and Einstein finally finds a mate
programme.desc: Explores the life of lions, their survival instincts and their habit of protecting their pride.

programme.title: ఎర్త్స్ ట్రాపికల్ ఐలాండ్స్
programme.sub-title: From the makers of Earth's Greatest Rivers, Earth's Tropical Islands journeys to three of the most exotic, mysterious and remote islands on planet Earth: Madagascar, Borneo and Hawaii. In three episodes, the series reveals how these isolated and iconic tropical islands harbour remarkable wildlife and human castaways found nowhere else on Earth. Madagascar is the oldest island in the world, Borneo cradles more diversity of life than any other island, and Hawaii is the remotest island chain in the world. In a rapidly changing world, these fragile islands are a vital gauge for the health of our planet
programme.desc: దర్శకుడు మడగాస్కర్, బోర్నియో, హవాయిలోని అన్యదేశ, మారుమూల ద్వీపాలలో మానవ జనాభా, వన్యప్రాణుల చరిత్రను అన్వేషిస్తారు.

programme.sub-title: Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals

programme.desc: Raised in an orphanage, Saanvi harbours a deep wish to reunite with her mother, Maya. Will they ever get to mend their relationship?

programme.title: Oh Humnava Tum Dena Saath Mera
programme.desc: Rakshit and Aparajita get emotional when they see their baby's scan. Later, Rakshit keeps a fast for Aparajita.

programme.title: Yeh Fitoor Tera
programme.desc: Chided by Anoop for standing by Jeet, Saumya shares her inner conflict with Krish. Later, after Uma guides her, she sees Jeet at the hospital during Sanjeev's critical need for blood.

programme.title: Udne Ki Aasha
programme.desc: Riya cautions Sachin about the contract, and Laksh joins in the dance. Meanwhile, Paresh encourages Sailee to go to Lonavala with Sachin, who is concerned about covering Pankhuri's school fees.

programme.title: Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai
programme.desc: Dr Abhimanyu, a misogamist, finds himself getting attracted to Akshara, Kartik and Naira's daughter. Things take a tricky turn when Akshara's half-sister, Arohi, falls in love with him.

programme.title: Anupamaa
programme.desc: Anupamaa sacrifices her personal ambitions to dedicate her life to her family. However, she eventually decides to live on her own terms after failing to receive credit for her many trials.

programme.title: Avatar - Herr der Elemente 2
Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Desert
programme.sub-title: In der Wüste
programme.desc: Mit Tophs Hilfe gelingt es Aang, Sokka, Katara and Momo, aus der im Sand versinkenden Bibliothek zu entkommen. Doch an der Oberfläche wartet schon die nächste unangenehme Überraschung auf die Freunde: Ihr fliegender Büffel Appa ist spurlos verschwunden! Ohne ihn scheint ein Entkommen aus der gefährlichen Si-Wong-Wüste unmöglich. Bei der Suche nach Appa stoßen Aang und seine Begleiter auf stechfreudige Riesenwespen und giftige Kakteen - und schließlich auf eine Gruppe von Sandbändigern, die Appa in ihre Gewalt gebracht haben. Suko und sein Onkel Iroh versuchen derweil, Xin-Fu zu entkommen. Der Meister des Erdbändiger-Turniers will unbedingt die Kopfprämie kassieren, die auf die beiden Feuerkrieger ausgesetzt ist.

programme.title: Avatar - Herr der Elemente 2
Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Serpent's Pass
programme.sub-title: Der Schlangenpass
programme.desc: Im Mittelpunkt von "Avatar - Der Herr der Elemente" steht der zwölfjährige Aang, der in einer von den Herren des Feuers beherrschten asiatischen Fantasy-Welt lebt. Aang ist nicht nur der letzte Herrscher über die Luft, sondern auch der Avatar, der Herr über alle Elemente. Er ist derjenige, der über die Form von Wasser, Erde, Luft und Feuer bestimmt. Doch der Avatar war 100 Jahre lang in einem Gletscher am Südpol eingefroren, und während dieser Zeit sind die Herrscher des Feuers ihrem Ziel der totalen Weltherrschaft immer näher gekommen. Erst als Aang von Katara, der letzten Gebieterin des Wassers, und deren Bruder Sokka aus dem ewigen Eis befreit wird, hat er eine Chance, seine Mission zu erfüllen: Er muss die aus den Fugen geratene Welt retten und die Balance der Elemente wiederherstellen. Eine große Herausforderung für einen Zwölfjährigen - schließlich muss er noch vieles lernen.

Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Drill
programme.sub-title: Bedrohlicher Bohrer
programme.desc: Im Mittelpunkt von "Avatar - Der Herr der Elemente" steht der zwölfjährige Aang, der in einer von den Herren des Feuers beherrschten asiatischen Fantasy-Welt lebt.
